4.1.6: kathayitvā tu tat sarvaṁ brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
4.1.9: sa sādhu kaunteya ito vāsamarjuna rocaya,
4.1.11: ramaṇīyāni guptāni teṣāṁ kiñcit sma rocaya ॥11॥
4.1.12: santi ramyā janapadā bahvannāḥ paritaḥ kurūn,
4.1.16: avaśyaṁ tveva vāsārthaṁ ramaṇīyaṁ śivaṁ sukham,
4.1.19: yāni yāni ca karmāṇi tasya vakṣyāmahe vayam,
āsādya matsyaṁ tat karma prabrūta kurunandanāḥ ॥19॥
4.1.20: naradeva kathaṁ tasya rāṣṭre karma kariṣyasi,
4.1.22: na duḥkhamucitaṁ kiñcid rājan veda yathā janaḥ,
sa imāmāpadaṁ prāpya kathaṁ ghorāṁ tariṣyasi ॥22॥
4.1.23: śr̥ṇudhvaṁ yat kariṣyāmi karma vai kurunandanāḥ,
4.1.24: kaṅko nāma dvijo bhūtvā matākṣaḥ priyadevanaḥ ॥24॥
4.1.26: na ca māṁ vetsyate kaścit toṣayiṣye ca taṁ nr̥pam ॥26॥
4.1.27: iti vakṣyāmi rājānaṁ yadi māṁ so’nuyokṣyate ॥27॥
4.1.28: vr̥kodara virāṭe tvaṁ raṁsyase kena hetunā ॥28॥
4.1.28d6: hiḍimbaṁ ca mahāvīryaṁ kirmīraṁ caiva rākṣasam,
tvayā hatvā mahābāho vanaṁ niṣkaṇṭakaṁ kr̥tam.
4.1.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirādimantraṇe prathamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥1॥
4.2.4: yat prekṣya vipulaṁ karma rājā saṁyokṣyate sa mām,
4.2.5: rājñastasya pare preṣyā maṁsyante māṁ yathā nr̥pam,
4.2.6: dvipā vā balino rājan vr̥ṣabhā vā mahābalāḥ,
4.2.7: tānahaṁ hi niyotsyāmi ratiṁ tasya vivardhayan ॥7॥
4.2.8: na tvetān yuddhyamānān vai haniṣyāmi kathañcana,
tathaitān pātayiṣyāmi yathā yāsyanti na kṣayam ॥8॥
4.2.12: so’yaṁ kiṁ karma kaunteyaḥ kariṣyati dhanañjayaḥ ॥12॥
4.2.14: śreṣṭho yaḥ pratiyodhānāṁ so’rjunaḥ kiṁ kariṣyati ॥14॥
4.2.15: sūryaḥ pratapatāṁ śreṣṭho dvipadāṁ brāhmaṇo varaḥ,
4.2.16: āyudhānāṁ varaṁ vajraṁ kakudmī ca gavāṁ varaḥ,
4.2.17: putraḥ priyāṇāmadhiko bhāryā ca suhr̥dāṁ varā ॥17॥
4.2.21: vasūnāṁ navamaṁ manye grahāṇāṁ daśamaṁ tathā ॥21॥
4.2.22: dakṣiṇe caiva savye ca gavāmiva vahaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥22॥
4.2.25: jyāghātau hi mahāntau me saṁvartuṁ nr̥pa duṣkarau ॥25॥
4.2.29: gītaṁ nr̥tyaṁ vicitraṁ ca vāditraṁ vividhaṁ tathā,
4.2.30: prajānāṁ samudācāraṁ bahu karma kr̥taṁ vadan,
4.2.31: uṣitāsmīti vakṣyāmi pr̥ṣṭo rājñā ca pāṇḍava ॥31॥
4.2.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirādimantraṇe dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ ॥2॥
4.3.2: kiṁ tvaṁ nakula kurvāṇastatra tāta cariṣyasi,
karma tat tvaṁ samācakṣva rājye tasya mahīpateḥ,
4.3.4: granthiko nāma nāmnāhaṁ karmaitat supriyaṁ mama,
priyāśca satataṁ me’śvāḥ kururāja yathā tava ॥4॥
4.3.7: kiṁ vā tvaṁ karma kurvāṇaḥ pracchanno vihariṣyasi ॥7॥
4.3.8: pratiṣeddhā ca dogdhā ca saṅkhyāne kuśalo gavām ॥8॥
4.3.9: nipuṇaṁ ca cariṣyāmi vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥9॥
4.3.10: ahaṁ hi satataṁ goṣu bhavatā prahitaḥ purā,
4.3.11: lakṣaṇaṁ caritaṁ cāpi gavāṁ yaccāpi maṅgalam,
4.3.13: so’hamevaṁ cariṣyāmi prītiratra hi me sadā,
na ca māṁ vetsyate kaścit toṣayiṣye ca pārthivam ॥13॥
4.3.14: iyaṁ hi naḥ priyā bhāryā prāṇebhyo’pi garīyasī,
māteva paripālyā ca pūjyā jyeṣṭheva ca svasā ॥14॥
4.3.15: kena sma draupadī kr̥ṣṇā karmaṇā vicariṣyati,
na hi kiñcid vijānāti karma kartuṁ yathā striyaḥ ॥15॥
4.3.16: sukumārī ca bālā ca rājaputrī yaśasvinī,
4.3.17d1: sairandhryo rakṣitā loke bhujiṣyāḥ santi bhārata,
naivamanyāḥ striyo yānti iti lokasya niścayaḥ.
4.3.19: uṣitāsmīti vakṣyāmi pr̥ṣṭā rājñā ca bhārata ॥19॥
4.3.21: sā rakṣiṣyati māṁ prāptāṁ mā bhūt te duḥkhamīdr̥śam ॥21॥
4.3.22: kalyāṇaṁ bhāṣase kr̥ṣṇe kule jātāsi bhāmini,
4.3.23: yathā na durhr̥daḥ pāpā bhavanti sukhinaḥ punaḥ,
kuryāstat tvaṁ hi kalyāṇi lakṣayeyurna te tathā ॥23॥
4.3.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirādimantraṇe tr̥tīyo’dhyāyaḥ ॥3॥
4.4.3: yāntu dvāravatīṁ śīghramiti me vartate matiḥ ॥3॥
4.4.5: sarvairapi ca vaktavyaṁ na prājñāyanta pāṇḍavāḥ,
4.4.7: vihitaṁ pāṇḍavāḥ sarvaṁ brāhmaṇeṣu suhr̥tsu ca,
4.4.8: tvayā rakṣā vidhātavyā kr̥ṣṇāyāḥ phālgunena ca,
viditaṁ vo yathā sarvaṁ lokavr̥ttamidaṁ tava ॥8॥
4.4.13: dr̥ṣṭadvāro labhed draṣṭuṁ rājasveṣu na viśvaset,
4.4.14: yo na yānaṁ na paryaṅkaṁ na pīṭhaṁ na gajaṁ ratham,
4.4.15: na tatropaviśed yo vai sa rājavasatiṁ vaset ॥15॥
4.4.18: naiṣāṁ dāreṣu kurvīta maitrīṁ prājñaḥ kadācana,
antaḥpuracarā ye ca dveṣṭi yānahitāśca ye ॥18॥
4.4.19: evaṁ vicarato rājñi na kṣatirjāyate kvacit ॥19॥
4.4.21: na hi putraṁ na naptāraṁ na bhrātaramarindamāḥ,
4.4.24: samarthanāsu sarvāsu hitaṁ ca priyameva ca,
4.4.25: apriyaṁ cāhitaṁ yat syāt tadasmai nānuvarṇayet ॥25॥
4.4.26: apramattaśca satataṁ hitaṁ kuryāt priyaṁ ca yat ॥26॥
4.4.28: dakṣiṇaṁ vātha vāmaṁ vā pārśvamāsīta paṇḍitaḥ,
4.4.29: nityaṁ hi pratiṣiddhaṁ tu purastādāsanaṁ mahat,
na ca sandarśane kiñcit pravr̥ttamapi sañjayet ॥29॥
4.4.32: śūro’smīti na dr̥ptaḥ syād buddhimāniti vā punaḥ,
4.4.33: aiśvaryaṁ prāpya duṣprāpaṁ priyaṁ prāpya ca rājataḥ,
apramatto bhaved rājñaḥ priyeṣu ca hiteṣu ca ॥33॥
4.4.35: na coṣṭhau na bhujau jānū na ca vākyaṁ samākṣipet,
sadā vātaṁ ca vācaṁ ca ṣṭhīvanaṁ cācarecchanaiḥ ॥35॥
4.4.37: na cātidhairyeṇa cared gurutāṁ hi vrajet tataḥ,
4.4.38: lābhe na harṣayed yastu na vyathed yo’vamānitaḥ,
asammūḍhaśca yo nityaṁ sa rājavasatiṁ vaset ॥38॥
4.4.39: rājānaṁ rājaputraṁ vā saṁvarṇayati yaḥ sadā,
amātyaḥ paṇḍito bhūtvā sa ciraṁ tiṣṭhate priyaḥ ॥39॥
4.4.40: na nirvadati rājānaṁ labhate sampadaṁ punaḥ ॥40॥
4.4.41: pratyakṣaṁ ca parokṣaṁ ca guṇavādī vicakṣaṇaḥ,
upajīvī bhaved rājño viṣaye yo’pi vā bhavet ॥41॥
4.4.42: amātyo hi balād bhoktuṁ rājānaṁ prārthayeta yaḥ,
na sa tiṣṭhecciraṁ sthānaṁ gacchecca prāṇasaṁśayam ॥42॥
4.4.43: śreyaḥ sadā’’tmano dr̥ṣṭvā paraṁ rājñā na saṁvadet,
4.4.45: anyasmin preṣyamāṇe tu purastād yaḥ samutpatet,
ahaṁ kiṁ karavāṇīti sa rājavasatiṁ vaset ॥45॥
4.4.46: āntare caiva bāhye ca rājñā yaścātha sarvadā,
ādiṣṭo naiva kampeta sa rājavasatiṁ vaset ॥46॥
4.4.47: yo vai gr̥hebhyaḥ pravasan priyāṇāṁ nānusaṁsmaret,
4.4.48: samaveṣaṁ na kurvīta noccaiḥ saṁnihito vaset,
na mantraṁ bahudhā kuryādevaṁ rājñaḥ priyo bhavet ॥48॥
4.4.49: na karmaṇi niyuktaḥ san dhanaṁ kiñcidapi spr̥śet,
prāpnoti hi haran dravyaṁ bandhanaṁ yadi vā vadham ॥49॥
4.4.52: anuśiṣṭāḥ sma bhadraṁ te naitad vaktāsti kaścana,
kuntīmr̥te mātaraṁ no viduraṁ vā mahāmatim ॥52॥
4.4.54: akarod vidhivat sarvaṁ prasthāne yad vidhīyate ॥54॥
4.4.55: teṣāṁ samidhya tānagnīn mantravacca juhāva saḥ,
4.4.57: gateṣu teṣu vīreṣu dhaumyo’tha japatāṁ varaḥ,
4.4.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi dhaumyopadeśe caturtho’dhyāyaḥ ॥4॥
4.5.4: lubdhā bruvāṇā matsyasya viṣayaṁ prāviśan vanāt ॥4॥
4.5.10: sāyudhāśca pravekṣyāmo vayaṁ tāta puraṁ yadi,
4.5.11: gāṇḍīvaṁ ca mahad gāḍhaṁ loke ca viditaṁ nr̥ṇām,
4.5.12: tato dvādaśa varṣāṇi praveṣṭavyaṁ vane punaḥ,
4.5.13: iyaṁ kūṭe manuṣyendra gahanā mahatī śamī,
4.5.14: na cāpi vidyate kaścinmanuṣya iti me matiḥ,
4.5.22: niśamya yasya visphāraṁ vyadravanta raṇāt pare,
4.5.25: kule nāsti samo rūpe yasyeti nakulaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥25॥
4.5.30: yatra cāpaśyata sa vai tirovarṣāṇi varṣati,
tatra tāni ṭr̥ḍhaiḥ pāśaiḥ sugāḍhaṁ paryabandhata ॥30॥
4.5.35: iti guhyāni nāmāni cakre teṣāṁ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥35॥
4.5.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi purapraveśe astrasaṁsthāpane pañcamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥5॥
4.6.5: tān vai tārayase pāpāt paṅke gāmiva durbalām ॥5॥
4.6.10: pātrī ca paṅkajī ghaṇṭī strīviśuddhā ca yā bhuvi ॥10॥
4.6.15: tena tvaṁ stūyase devi tridaśaiḥ pūjyase’pi ca,
prasannā me suraśreṣṭhe dayāṁ kuru śivā bhava ॥15॥
4.6.16: jayā tvaṁ vijayā caiva saṅgrāme ca jayapradā,
mamāpi vijayaṁ dehi varadā tvaṁ ca sāmpratam ॥16॥
4.6.17: vindhye caiva nagaśreṣṭhe tava sthānaṁ hi śāśvatam,
4.6.18: bhārāvatāre ye ca tvāṁ saṁsmariṣyanti mānavāḥ ॥18॥
4.6.19: praṇamanti ca ye tvāṁ hi prabhāte tu narā bhuvi,
na teṣāṁ durlabhaṁ kiñcit putrato dhanato’pi vā ॥19॥
4.6.20: durgāt tārayase durge tat tvaṁ durgā smr̥tā janaiḥ,
4.6.21: dasyubhirvā niruddhānāṁ tvaṁ gatiḥ paramā nr̥ṇām,
4.6.22: ye smaranti mahādevi na ca sīdanti te narāḥ,
4.6.23: sandhyā rātriḥ prabhā nidrā jyotsnā kāntiḥ kṣamā dayā,
nr̥ṇāṁ ca bandhanaṁ mohaṁ putranāśaṁ dhanakṣayam ॥23॥
4.6.24: vyādhiṁ mr̥tyuṁ bhayaṁ caiva pūjitā nāśayiṣyasi,
so’haṁ rājyāt paribhraṣṭaḥ śaraṇaṁ tvāṁ prapannavān ॥24॥
4.6.25: praṇataśca yathā mūrdhnā tava devi sureśvari,
trāhi māṁ padmapatrākṣi satye satyā bhavasva naḥ ॥25॥
4.6.26: śaraṇaṁ bhava me durge śaraṇye bhaktavatsale,
evaṁ stutā hi sā devī darśayāmāsa pāṇḍavam ॥26॥
4.6.27: śr̥ṇu rājan mahābāho madīyaṁ vacanaṁ prabho ॥27॥
4.6.29: rājyaṁ niṣkapaṭakaṁ kr̥tvā bhokṣyase medinīṁ punaḥ,
4.6.32: ye smariṣyanti māṁ rājan yathāhaṁ bhavatā smr̥tā ॥32॥
4.6.33: idaṁ stotravaraṁ bhaktyā śr̥ṇuyād vā paṭheta vā ॥33॥
4.6.34: tasya sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhiṁ yāsyanti pāṇḍavāḥ,
4.6.35: na prajñāsyanti kuravo narā vā tannivāsinaḥ,
4.6.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi durgāstave ṣaṣṭho’dhyāyaḥ ॥6॥
4.7.0d5: sa me prasanno bhagavān varaṁ dadau
4.7.0d6: sa vai mayokto varadaḥ pitā prabhuḥ
4.7.0d7: vrataṁ ca satyaṁ ca samāptireva ca,
4.7.6: na cāsya dāso na ratho na kuñjaraḥ
4.7.11: gotraṁ ca nāmāpi ca śaṁsa tattvataḥ
kiṁ cāpi śilpaṁ tava vidyate kr̥tam ॥11॥
4.7.14: na vidyate kaṁ ca na matsya hīnataḥ,
na me jitaḥ kaścana dhārayed dhanaṁ
4.7.17: na te bhayaṁ vidyati saṁnidhau mama ॥17॥
4.7.18: evaṁ sa labdhvā tu varaṁ samāgamaṁ
4.7.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirapraveśo nāma saptamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥7॥
4.8.1: khajāṁ ca darbīṁ ca kareṇa dhāraya-
4.8.8: śriyā ca rūpeṇa ca vikrameṇa ca
4.8.11: na caiva manye tava karma yat samaṁ
4.8.13: uvāsa rājye na ca taṁ pr̥thag jano
4.8.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi bhīmapraveśe aṣṭamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥8॥
4.9.1: kr̥ṣṇān sūkṣmān mr̥dūn dīrghān samudgrathya śucismitā ॥1॥
4.9.4: apr̥cchaṁścaiva tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kā tvaṁ kiṁ ca cikīrṣasi,
4.9.5: karma cecchāmi vai kartuṁ tasya yo māṁ yuyukṣati,
tasyā rūpeṇa veṣeṇa ślakṣṇayā ca tathā girā,
4.9.7: samāhūyābravīd bhadre kā tvaṁ kiṁ ca cikīrṣasi ॥7॥
4.9.8: karma cecchāmyahaṁ kartuṁ tasya yo māṁ yuyukṣati ॥8॥
4.9.14: kā tvaṁ brūhi yathā bhadre nāsi dāsī kathañcana,
yakṣī vā yadi vā devī gandharvī yadi vāpsarāḥ ॥14॥
4.9.15: vidyādharī kinnarī vā yadi vā rohiṇī svayam ॥15॥
4.9.16: indrāṇī vāruṇī vā tvaṁ tvaṣṭurdhātuḥ prajāpateḥ,
devyo deveṣu vikhyātāstāsāṁ tvaṁ katamā śubhe ॥16॥
4.9.17: nāsmi devī na gandharvī nāsurī na ca rākṣasī,
sairandhrī tu bhujiṣyāsmi satyametad bravīmi te ॥17॥
4.9.18: keśān jānāmyahaṁ kartuṁ piṁṣe sādhu vilepanam,
4.9.21: vāsāṁsi yāvanti labhe tāvat tāvad rame tathā,
mālinītyeva me nāma svayaṁ devī cakāra sā,
4.9.22: mūrdhni tvāṁ vāsayeyaṁ vai saṁśayo me na vidyate,
na cedicchati rājā tvāṁ gacchet sarveṇa cetasā ॥22॥
4.9.23: striyo rājakule yāśca yāścemā mama veśmani,
prasaktāstvāṁ nirīkṣante pumāṁsaṁ kaṁ na mohayeḥ ॥23॥
4.9.24: vr̥kṣāṁścāvasthitān paśya ya ime mama veśmani,
te’pi tvāṁ saṁnamantīva pumāṁsaṁ kaṁ na mohayeḥ ॥24॥
4.9.25: vihāya māṁ varārohe gacchet sarveṇa cetasā ॥25॥
4.9.28: rājaveśmani te subhru gr̥he tu syāt tathā mama ॥28॥
4.9.30: nāsmi labhyā virāṭena na cānyena kadācana,
gandharvāḥ patayo mahyaṁ yuvānaḥ pañca bhāmini ॥30॥
4.9.31: rakṣanti te ca māṁ nityaṁ duḥkhācārā tathā hyaham ॥31॥
4.9.32: yo me na dadyāducchiṣṭaṁ na ca pādau pradhāvayet,
4.9.33: yo hi māṁ puruṣo gr̥ddhyed yathānyāḥ prākr̥tāḥ striyaḥ,
tāmeva nivased rātriṁ praviśya ca parāṁ tanum ॥33॥
4.9.34: duḥkhaśīlā hi gandharvāste ca me balinaḥ priyāḥ ॥34॥
4.9.35: pracchannāścāpi rakṣanti te māṁ nityaṁ śucismite,
evaṁ tvāṁ vāsayiṣyāmi yathā tvaṁ nandinīcchasi ॥35॥
4.9.36: na ca pādau na cocchiṣṭaṁ sprakṣyasi tvaṁ kathañcana,
4.9.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi draupadīpraveśe navamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥9॥
4.10.4: kasya vā tvaṁ kuto vā tvaṁ kiṁ vā tvaṁ tu cikīrṣasi,
na hi me dr̥ṣṭapūrvastvaṁ tattvaṁ brūhi nararṣabha ॥4॥
4.10.6: tān rājasiṁhān na hi vedmi pārthān,
na ca tvadanyo mama rocate nr̥paḥ ॥6॥
4.10.8: kiṁ vāpi śilpaṁ tava vidyate kr̥tam,
4.10.10: teṣāṁ gosaṅkhya āsaṁ vai tantipāleti māṁ viduḥ ॥10॥
4.10.11: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca yacca saṅkhyāgataṁ gavām,
4.10.12: guṇāḥ suviditā hyāsan mama tasya mahātmanaḥ,
asakr̥t sa mayā tuṣṭaḥ kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥12॥
4.10.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi sahadevapraveśe daśamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥10॥
4.11.6: sutaiḥ samo me bhava vā mayā samaḥ ॥6॥
4.11.9: idaṁ tu rūpaṁ mama yena kiṁ tava
4.11.10: sutāṁ ca me nartaya yāśca tādr̥śīḥ,
idaṁ tu te karma samaṁ na me mataṁ
4.11.14: tathā ca taṁ tatra na jajñire janā
4.11.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi arjunapraveśo nāma ekādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥11॥
4.12.5: prabrūhi śilpaṁ tava vidyate ca yat ॥5॥
4.12.7: aśvānāṁ prakr̥tiṁ vedmi vinayaṁ cāpi sarvaśaḥ,
duṣṭānāṁ pratipattiṁ ca kr̥tsnaṁ caiva cikitsitam ॥7॥
4.12.8: na me’sti duṣṭā vaḍavā kuto hayāḥ,
4.12.11: kathaṁ tu bhr̥tyaiḥ sa vinākr̥to vane
4.12.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi pāṇḍavapraveśaparvaṇi nakulapraveśe dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥12॥
4.13.1: ata ūrdhvaṁ mahāvīryāḥ kimakurvata vai dvija ॥1॥
4.13.6: ajñātaṁ ca virāṭasya vijitya vasu dharmarāṭ,
4.13.9: dadhi kṣīraṁ ghr̥taṁ caiva pāṇḍavebhyaḥ prayacchati ॥9॥
4.13.10: nakulo’pi dhanaṁ labdhvā kr̥te karmaṇi vājinām,
4.13.11: kr̥ṣṇā tu sarvān bhartr̥̄ṁstān nirīkṣantī tapasvinī,
4.13.14: atha māse caturthe tu brahmaṇaḥ sumahotsavaḥ,
4.13.19: atha sūdena taṁ mallaṁ yodhayāmāsa matsyarāṭ ॥19॥
4.13.20: na hi śaknoti vivr̥te pratyākhyātuṁ narādhipam ॥20॥
4.13.23: jīmūtaṁ nāma taṁ tatra mallaṁ prakhyātavikramam,
4.13.35: tato mallāśca matsyāśca vismayaṁ cakrire param ॥35॥
4.13.38: praharṣāt pradadau vittaṁ bahu rājā mahāmanāḥ,
4.13.39: evaṁ sa subahūn mallān puruṣāṁśca mahābalān,
4.13.40: yadāsya tulyaḥ puruṣo na kaścit tatra vidyate,
4.13.44: tasmai pradeyaṁ prāyacchat prīto rājā dhanaṁ bahu,
4.13.45: draupadī prekṣya tān sarvān kliśyamānān mahārathān,
4.13.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi samayapālanaparvaṇi jīmūtavadhe trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥13॥
4.14.8: cittaṁ hi nirmathya karoti māṁ vaśe
4.14.12: kā tvaṁ kasyāsi kalyāṇi kuto vā tvaṁ varānane,
4.14.13: kāntyā vibhāti vaktraṁ te śaśāṅka iva nirmalam ॥13॥
4.14.16: lakṣmīḥ padmālayā kā tvamatha bhūtiḥ sumadhyame,
hrīḥ śrīḥ kīrtiratho kāntirāsāṁ kā tvaṁ varānane ॥16॥
4.14.19: kr̥tsne jagati ko neha kāmasya vaśago bhavet ॥19॥
4.14.20: sujātau sahitau lakṣmyā pīnau vr̥ttau nirantarau ॥20॥
4.14.28: kāmaṁ prakāmaṁ seva tvaṁ mayā saha vilāsini ॥28॥
4.14.33: ahaṁ ca te sundari dāsavat sthitaḥ
4.14.34d5: priyā hi prāṇināṁ dārāstasmāt tvaṁ dharmabhāg bhava,
paradārarato martyo na ca bhadrāṇi paśyati.
4.14.35: paradārāsmi bhadraṁ te na yuktaṁ tava sāmpratam,
4.14.36: paradāre na te buddhirjātu kāryā kathañcana,
4.14.37: ayaśaḥ prāpnuyād ghoraṁ mahad vā prāpnuyād bhayam ॥37॥
4.14.41: pratyākhyāya ca māṁ bhīru vaśagaṁ priyavādinam,
4.14.42: ahaṁ hi subhru rājyasya kr̥tsnasyāsya sumadhyame,
4.14.44: bhoktavyeṣu ca kalyāṇi kasmād dāsye ratā hyasi ॥44॥
4.14.46: evamuktā tu sā sādhvī kīcakenāśubhaṁ vacaḥ,
4.14.47: mā sūtaputra muhyasva mādya tyakṣyasva jīvitam,
4.14.48: na cāpyahaṁ tvayā labhyā gandharvāḥ patayo mama,
te tvāṁ nihanyuḥ kupitāḥ sādhvalaṁ mā vyanīnaśaḥ ॥48॥
4.14.52: teṣāṁ priyāṁ prārthayato na te bhuvi
na vartate kīcaka te dr̥śā śubhaṁ
4.14.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi kīcakakr̥ṣṇāsaṁvāde caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥14॥
4.15.2: yathā kaikeyi sairandhrī sameyāt tad vidhīyatām,
taṁ sudeṣṇe parīpsasva prāṇān mohāt prahāsiṣam ॥2॥
4.15.3: tasya sā bahuśaḥ śrutvā vācaṁ vilapatastadā,
4.15.3d1: śaraṇāgateyaṁ suśroṇī mayā dattābhayā ca sā,
śubhācārā ca bhadraṁ te naināṁ vaktumihotsahe.
4.15.3d2: naiṣā śakyā hi cānyena spraṣṭuṁ pāpena cetasā,
gandharvāḥ kila pañcaināṁ rakṣanti ramayanti ca.
4.15.3d4: te hi kuddhā mahātmāno nāśayeyurhi jīvitam,
4.15.3d8: sairandhryā hyetadākhyātaṁ mama teṣāṁ mahad balam,
4.15.3d9: mā gamiṣyasi vai kr̥cchrāṁ gatiṁ paramadurgamām,
balinaste rujaṁ kuryuḥ kulasya ca dhanasya ca.
4.15.3d10: tasmānnāsyāṁ manaḥ kartuṁ yadi prāṇāḥ priyāstava,
mā cintayethā mā gāstvaṁ matpriyaṁ ca yadīcchasi.
4.15.3d12: ahameko haniṣyāmi gandharvān pañca kiṁ punaḥ,
4.15.3d13: aho duḥkhamaho kr̥cchramaho pāpamiti sma ha,
prārudad bhr̥śaduḥkhārtā vipākaṁ tasya vīkṣya sā.
4.15.3d15: kiṁ nu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ yat tvamevamabhiplutaḥ,
4.15.3d16: akartavye hi māṁ pāpe niyunaṅkṣi narādhama.
4.15.3d19: etat tu me duḥkhataraṁ yenāhaṁ bhrātr̥sauhr̥dāt,
4.15.5: parvaṇi tvaṁ samuddiśya surāmannaṁ ca kāraya,
4.15.7: ityuktaḥ sa viniṣkramya bhaginyā vacanāt tadā,
4.15.9d2: madhu madyaṁ bahuvidhaṁ bhakṣyāśca vividhāḥ kr̥tāḥ,
sudeṣṇe brūhi sairandhrīṁ yathā sā me gr̥haṁ vrajet.
4.15.9d3: kenacit tvadya kāryeṇa tvara śīghraṁ mama priyam.
4.15.9d4: ahaṁ hi śaraṇaṁ devaṁ prapadye vr̥ṣabhadhvajam,
samāgamaṁ me sairandhryā maraṇaṁ vā diśeti vai.
4.15.9d5: sā tamāha viniḥśvasya pratigaccha svakaṁ gr̥ham,
4.15.11: tvameva rājñi jānāsi yathā sa nirapatrapaḥ ॥11॥
4.15.13: tvaṁ caiva devi jānāsi yathā sa samayaḥ kr̥taḥ,
praviśantyā mayā pūrvaṁ tava veśmani bhāmini ॥13॥
4.15.14: so’vamaṁsyati māṁ dr̥ṣṭvā na yāsye tatra śobhane ॥14॥
4.15.15: anyāṁ preṣaya bhadraṁ te sa hi māmavamaṁsyate ॥15॥
4.15.16: naiva tvāṁ jātu hiṁsyāt sa itaḥ sampreṣitāṁ mayā,
4.15.18: tena satyena māṁ prāptāṁ mā kuryāt kīcako vaśe ॥18॥
4.15.21: tāṁ mr̥gīmiva santrastāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kr̥ṣṇāṁ samīpagām,
4.15.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi draupadīsurāharaṇe pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥15॥
4.16.1: svāgataṁ te sukeśānte suvyuṣṭā rajanī mama,
4.16.3: ehi tatra mayā sārdhaṁ pibasva madhumādhavīm ॥3॥
4.16.3d1: nāhaṁ śakyā tvayā spraṣṭuṁ niṣādeneva brāhmaṇī,
4.16.4: pānamāhara me kṣipraṁ pipāsā me’ti cābravīt ॥4॥
4.16.12d1: brāhmaṇānāṁ ca vr̥ddhānāṁ kṣatriyāṇāṁ ca paśyatām.
4.16.12d2: tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tatra te sabhyā hāhābhūtāḥ samantataḥ.
4.16.12d3: na yuktaṁ sūtaputreti kīcaketi ca mānavāḥ,
4.16.14: tasya bhīmo vadhaṁ prepsuḥ kīcakasya durātmanaḥ,
4.16.19: ālokayasi kiṁ vr̥kṣaṁ sūda dārukr̥tena vai,
4.16.19d3: bhīmasya tu samārambhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājñaśca ceṣṭitam,
draupadyabhyadhikaṁ kruddhā prārudat sā punaḥ punaḥ.
4.16.21d1: kāryaṁ hi pālanaṁ nityaṁ dharme satye ca tiṣṭhatām.
4.16.21d2: priyeṣvapi ca dveṣyeṣu samatvaṁ ye samāśritāḥ.
4.16.21d7: acirāt taṁ durātmānaṁ vaśe kurvanti śatravaḥ.
4.16.21d8: matsyānāṁ kulajastvaṁ hi teṣāṁ satyaṁ parāyaṇam,
4.16.21d15: etad vo mānuṣāḥ samyak kāryaṁ dvandvatayā bhuvi,
asmin sunīte durnīte labhate karmajaṁ phalam.
4.16.21d16: tena gacchati saṁsargaṁ svargāya narakāya vā.
4.16.21d17: sukr̥taṁ duṣkr̥taṁ vāpi kr̥tvā mohena mānavaḥ,
4.16.21d19: tathā tvamapi rājendra kāryākārye sthiro bhava.
4.16.22: yeṣāṁ vairī na svapiti ṣaṣṭhe’pi viṣaye vasan,
teṣāṁ māṁ māninīṁ bhāryāṁ sūtaputraḥ padāvadhīt ॥22॥
4.16.23: teṣāṁ māṁ māninīṁ bhāryāṁ sūtaputraḥ padāvadhīt ॥23॥
4.16.24: teṣāṁ māṁ māninīṁ bhāryāṁ sūtaputraḥ padāvadhīt ॥24॥
4.16.25: teṣāṁ māṁ māninīṁ bhāryāṁ sūtaputraḥ padāvadhīt ॥25॥
4.16.26: teṣāṁ māṁ māninīṁ bhāryāṁ sūtaputraḥ padāvadhīt ॥26॥
4.16.27: caranti loke pracchannāḥ kva nu te’dya mahārathāḥ ॥27॥
4.16.28: kathaṁ te sūtaputreṇa vadhyamānāṁ priyāṁ satīm,
4.16.29: kva nu teṣāmamarṣaśca vīryaṁ tejaśca vartate,
na parīpsanti ye bhāryāṁ vadhyamānāṁ durātmanā ॥29॥
4.16.30: mayātra śakyaṁ kiṁ kartuṁ virāṭe dharmadūṣake,
4.16.31: na rājā rājavat kiñcit samācarati kīcake,
dasyūnāmiva dharmaste na hi saṁsadi śobhate ॥31॥
4.16.32: nāhametena yuktaṁ vai hantuṁ matsya tavāntike,
4.16.33: kīcako na ca dharmajño na ca matsyaḥ kathañcana,
4.16.35: arthatattvamavijñāya kiṁ nu syāt kauśalaṁ mama ॥35॥
4.16.36: sādhu sādhviti cāpyāhuḥ kīcakaṁ ca vyagarhayan ॥36॥
4.16.37: paro lābhastu tasya syānna ca śocet kathañcana ॥37॥
4.16.37d1: yasyā gātraṁ śubhaṁ pīnaṁ mukhaṁ jayati paṅkajam,
gatirhaṁsaṁ smitaṁ kundaṁ saiṣā nārhati padvadham.
4.16.37d2: snigdhāśca mr̥davaḥ keśāḥ saiṣā nārhati padvadham.
4.16.37d3: padmaṁ cakraṁ dhvajaṁ śaṅkhaṁ prāsādo makarastathā,
yasyāḥ pāṇitale santi saiṣā nārhati padvadham.
4.16.37d4: āvartāḥ khalu catvāraḥ sarve caiva pradakṣiṇāḥ,
samaṁ gātraṁ śubhaṁ snigdhaṁ yasya nārhati padvadham.
4.16.37d6: surūpiṇī suvadanā neyaṁ yogyā padā vadham.
4.16.37d7: apsarā iva saurūpyānneyaṁ yogyā padā vadham.
4.16.39: yudhiṣṭhirasya kopāt tu lalāṭe sveda āgamat ॥39॥
4.16.40: gaccha sairandhri mātra sthāḥ sudeṣṇāyā niveśanam ॥40॥
4.16.42: manye na kālaṁ krodhasya paśyanti patayastava,
4.16.42d2: nāsti kaścit striyā yajño na śrāddhaṁ nāpyupoṣaṇam,
yā ca bhartari śuśrūṣā sā svargāyābhijāyate.
4.16.42d3: pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane,
putrastu sthavire bhāve na strī svātatantryamarhati.
4.16.42d4: bhartr̥̄n prati tathā patnyo na krudhyanti kadācana,
4.16.42d5: na kruddhān prati yāyād vai patīṁste vr̥trahā api.
4.16.42d6: yadi te samayaḥ kaścit kr̥to hyāyatalocane,
taṁ smarasva kṣamāśīle kṣamā dharmo hyanuttamaḥ.
4.16.42d7: kṣamā satyaṁ kṣamā dānaṁ kṣamā dharmaḥ kṣamā tapaḥ,
4.16.44: gaccha sairandhri gandharvāḥ kariṣyanti tava priyam,
vyapaneṣyanti te duḥkhaṁ yena te vipriyaṁ kr̥tam ॥44॥
4.16.45: tasya tasyaiva te vadhyā yeṣāṁ jyeṣṭho’kṣadevitā ॥45॥
4.16.47: śuśubhe vadanaṁ tasyā rudatyāḥ suciraṁ tadā,
4.16.47d3: tāṁ te dr̥ṣṭvā tathā kr̥ṣṇāṁ kṣamiṇo dharmacāriṇaḥ.
4.16.48: kasyādya na sukhaṁ bhadre kena te vipriyaṁ kr̥tam ॥48॥
4.16.48d3: tīṁ niḥśvasyābravīt kr̥ṣṇā jānantī nāma pr̥cchasi,
bhrātre tvaṁ māmanupreṣya kimevaṁ tvaṁ vikatthase.
4.16.49: kīcako māvadhīt tatra surāhārīṁ gatāṁ tava,
sabhāyāṁ paśyato rājño yathaiva vijane vane ॥49॥
4.16.51: anye cainaṁ vadhiṣyanti yeṣāmāgaḥ karoti saḥ,
4.16.51d1: bhrātuḥ prayaccha tvaritā jīvaśrāddhaṁ tvamadya vai,
sudr̥ṣṭaṁ kuru vai cainaṁ nāsūn manye dhariṣyati.
4.16.51d2: teṣāṁ hi mama bhartr̥̄ṇāṁ pañcānāṁ dharmacāriṇām,
4.16.51d3: na ca saṅkrudhyate tāvad gandharvaḥ kāmarūpadhr̥k.
4.16.51d5: na ca snāti na cāśnāti na pāṁsūn parimārjati.
4.16.51d7: tāṁ tathā śokasantaptāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā praruditāṁ striyaḥ,
4.16.51d8: aho duḥkhataraṁ prāptā kīcakena padā hatā,
4.16.51d9: duḥśalāṁ mānayantī yā bhartr̥̄ṇāṁ bhaginīṁ śubhām,
4.16.51d10: nāśapat taṁ mahābhāgā kr̥ṣṇā pādena tāḍitā.
4.16.51d13: kasya vaṁśe samudbhūtaḥ sa ca durlalito mune,
4.16.51d14: etat sarvaṁ tathā vakṣye vistareṇaiva pārthiva.
4.16.51d15: prātilomyena jātānāṁ sa hyeko dvija eva tu.
4.16.51d18: teṣāṁ tu sūtaviṣayaḥ sūtānāṁ nāmataḥ kr̥taḥ,
upajīvya ca yat kṣatraṁ labdhaṁ sūtena tat purā.
4.16.51d22: tāṁ virāṭasya mātsyasya kekayaḥ pradadau mudā,
4.16.51d25: sadā paricaran prītyā virāṭe nyavasat sukhī.
4.16.51d26: virāṭasyaiva saṁhr̥ṣṭā balaṁ kośaṁ ca vardhayan.
4.16.51d27: kāleyā nāma daiteyāḥ prāyaśo bhuvi viśrutāḥ,
4.16.51d30: kīcakena raṇe bhagnā vyadravanta diśo daśa.
4.16.51d33: etat te kathitaṁ sarvaṁ kīcakasya parākramam.
4.16.51d34: draupadī na śaśāpainaṁ yasmāt tad gadataḥ śr̥ṇu,
kṣaratīti tapaḥ krodhādr̥ṣayo na śapanti hi.
4.16.51d35: jānantī tad yathātattvaṁ pāñcālī na śaśāpa tam,
kṣamā dharmaḥ kṣamā dānaṁ kṣamā yajñaḥ kṣamā yaśaḥ,
kṣamā satyaṁ kṣamā śīlaṁ kṣamā kīrtiḥ kṣamā param.
4.16.51d36: kṣamā puṇyaṁ kṣamā tīrthaṁ kṣamā sarvamiti śrutiḥ,
4.16.51d37: nāśapat taṁ viśālākṣī satī śaktāpi bhārata.
4.16.51d38: pāṇḍavāścāpi te sarve draupadīṁ prekṣya duḥkhitāḥ,
4.16.51d40: mahānase tadā kr̥cchrāt suṣvāpa rajanīṁ ca tām.
4.16.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi draupadīparibhave ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥16॥
4.17.2: kr̥tvā śaucaṁ yathānyāyaṁ kr̥ṣṇā sā tanumadhyamā ॥2॥
4.17.3: gātrāṇi vāsasī caiva prakṣālya salilena sā,
4.17.4: kiṁ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṁ kāryaṁ bhavenmama,
ityevaṁ cintayitvā sā bhīmaṁ vai manasāgamat ॥4॥
4.17.5: nānyaḥ kartā r̥te bhīmānmamādya manasaḥ priyam,
tata utthāya rātrau sā vihāya śayanaṁ svakam ॥5॥
4.17.8: tat karma kr̥tavānadya kathaṁ nidrāṁ niṣevase,
4.17.9: yasyāṁ bhīmastathā śete mr̥garāja iva śvasan,
tasyā rūpeṇa sā śālā bhīmasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥9॥
4.17.10: sā vai mahānasaṁ prāpya bhīmasenaṁ śucismitā ॥10॥
4.17.15: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha kiṁ śeṣe bhīmasena yathā mr̥taḥ,
4.17.18: na te prakr̥timān varṇaḥ kr̥śā pāṇḍuśca lakṣyase,
4.17.19: sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ dveṣyaṁ vā yadi vā priyam,
yathāvat sarvamācakṣva śrutvā jñāsyāmi yat kṣamam ॥19॥
4.17.20: ahameva hi te kr̥ṣṇe viśvāsyaḥ sarvakarmasu,
ahamāpatsu cāpi tvāṁ mokṣayāmi punaḥ punaḥ ॥20॥
4.17.21: śīghramuktvā yathākāmaṁ yat te kāryaṁ vivakṣitam,
gaccha vai śayanāyaiva purā nānyena budhyate ॥21॥
4.17.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi draupadībhīmasaṁvāde saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥17॥
4.18.0d1: sā lajjamānā bhītā ca adhomukhamukhī tataḥ,
4.18.1: jānan sarvāṇi duḥkhāni kiṁ māṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥1॥
4.18.2d1: śvaśurābhyāṁ ca bhīṣmeṇa vidureṇa ca dhīmatā.
4.18.2d2: droṇena ca mahābāho kr̥peṇa ca parantapa,
4.18.2d3: keśe gr̥hītvaiva sabhāṁ nītā jīvati vai tvayi,
4.18.3: pārthivasya sutā nāma kā nu jīvati mādr̥śī,
4.18.4: parāmarśo dvitīyo vai soḍhumutsahate tu kā ॥4॥
4.18.4d3: gośīrṣakaṁ padmakaṁ ca hariśyāmaṁ ca candanam.
4.18.4d4: nityaṁ piṁṣe virāṭasya tvayi jīvati pāṇḍava.
4.18.4d5: sāhaṁ bahūni duḥkhāni gaṇayāmi na te kr̥te,
agnikuṇḍāt samudbhūtā norvyāṁ jātu carāmi bhoḥ.
4.18.5: kīcakena parāmr̥ṣṭā kā nu jīvati mādr̥śī ॥5॥
4.18.6: evaṁ bahuvidhaiḥ kleśaiḥ kliśyamānāṁ ca bhārata,
na māṁ jānāsi kaunteya kiṁ phalaṁ jīvitena me ॥6॥
4.18.7: yo’yaṁ rājño virāṭasya kīcako nāma bhārata,
4.18.8: nityamevāha duṣṭātmā bhāryā mama bhaveti vai ॥8॥
4.18.9: kāleneva phalaṁ pakvaṁ hr̥dayaṁ me vidīryate ॥9॥
4.18.9d1: vijānāmi tavāmarṣaṁ balaṁ vīryaṁ ca pāṇḍava,
4.18.11: ko hi rājyaṁ parityajya sarvasvaṁ cātmanā saha,
4.18.14: tūṣṇīmāste yathā mūḍhaḥ svāni karmāṇi cintayan ॥14॥
4.18.25: sa eṣa nirayaṁ prāpto matsyasya paricārakaḥ,
sabhāyāṁ devitā rājñaḥ kaṅko brūte yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥25॥
4.18.27: sa vaśe vivaśo rājā pareṣāmadya vartate ॥27॥
4.18.31: dr̥ṣṭvā kasya na duḥkhaṁ syād dharmātmānaṁ yudhiṣṭhiram ॥31॥
4.18.32: upāste sma sabhāyāṁ yaṁ kr̥tsnā vīra vasundharā,
4.18.33: śokasāgaramadhyasthāṁ ki māṁ bhīma na paśyasi ॥33॥
4.18.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi draupadībhīmasaṁvāde aṣṭādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥18॥
4.19.1: idaṁ tu te mahad duḥkhaṁ yat pravakṣyāmi bhārata,
4.19.2: bruvan ballavajātīyaḥ kasya śokaṁ na vardhayeḥ ॥2॥
4.19.3: preṣyatvaṁ samanuprāptaṁ tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim ॥3॥
4.19.4: bruvāṇo ballavaḥ sūdastadā sīdati me manaḥ ॥4॥
4.19.5: yadā prahr̥ṣṭaḥ samrāṭ tvāṁ saṁyodhayati kuñjaraiḥ,
4.19.10: strīṇāṁ cittaṁ ca durjñeyaṁ yuktarūpau ca me matau,
4.19.11: iti bruvāṇā vākyāni sā māṁ nityamatarjayat ॥11॥
4.19.12: krudhyantīṁ māṁ ca samprekṣya samaśaṅkata māṁ tvayi,
tasyāṁ tathā bruvatyāṁ tu duḥkhaṁ māṁ mahadāviśat ॥12॥
4.19.14: so’yaṁ rājño virāṭasya kanyānāṁ nartako yuvā ॥14॥
4.19.20: kanyāparivr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhīma sīdati me manaḥ ॥20॥
4.19.23: so’yaṁ rājño virāṭasya kanyānāṁ nartako yuvā,
4.19.25: yasmin jāte mahābhāge kuntyāḥ śoko vyanaśyata,
4.19.27: yasya nāsti samo vīrye kaścidurvyāṁ dhanurdharaḥ,
4.19.28: dharme śaurye ca satye ca jīvalokasya sammatam,
strīveṣavikr̥taṁ pārthaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sīdati me manaḥ ॥28॥
4.19.30: paśyāmi tūryamadhyasthaṁ diśo naśyanti me tadā ॥30॥
4.19.31: nūnamāryā na jānāti kr̥cchraṁ prāptaṁ dhanañjayam,
4.19.31d3: brāhmaṁ pāśupataṁ caiva sthūṇākarṇaṁ ca darśayan.
4.19.31d5: strīveṣavikr̥taṁ pārthaṁ kuntīṁ gacchati me manaḥ.
4.19.32: tathā dr̥ṣṭvā yavīyāṁsaṁ sahadevaṁ gavāṁ patim,
4.19.35: dūyāmi bharataśreṣṭha dr̥ṣṭvā te bhrātaraṁ priyam,
4.19.37: sahadevaṁ hi me vīra nityamāryā praśaṁsati,
4.19.40: ityuvāca hi māṁ kuntī rudatī putragr̥ddhinī,
4.19.41: sahadevaṁ yudhāṁ śreṣṭhaṁ kiṁ nu jīvāmi pāṇḍava ॥41॥
4.19.45: kiṁ nu māṁ manyase pārtha sukhinīti parantapa,
4.19.46: vartante mayi kaunteya vakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu tānyapi ॥46॥
4.19.47: śoṣayanti śarīraṁ me kiṁ nu duḥkhamataḥ param ॥47॥
4.19.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi draupadībhīmasaṁvāde ekonaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥19॥
4.20.2: vikriyāṁ paśya me tīvrāṁ rājaputryāḥ parantapa,
4.20.5: parājaye ca hetuśca sa iti pratipālaye,
kiṁ māṁ na pratijānīṣe bhīmasena mr̥tāmiva ॥5॥
4.20.6: dattvā yācanti puruṣā hatvā vadhyanti cāpare,
pātayitvā ca pātyante parairiti ca me śrutam ॥6॥
4.20.8: sthitaṁ pūrvaṁ jalaṁ yatra punastatraiva gacchati,
4.20.10: yat tu me vacanasyāsya kathitasya prayojanam,
pr̥ccha māṁ duḥkhitāṁ tattvaṁ pr̥ṣṭā cātra bravīmi te ॥10॥
4.20.13: evaṁ samuditā nārī kā tvanyā duḥkhitā bhavet ॥13॥
4.20.14: nūnaṁ hi bālayā dhāturmayā vai vipriyaṁ kr̥tam,
4.20.15: tādr̥śo me na tatrāsīd duḥkhe paramake tadā ॥15॥
4.20.16: tvameva bhīma jānīṣe yanme pārtha sukhaṁ purā,
4.20.18: aśakyā vedituṁ pārtha prāṇināṁ vai gatirnaraiḥ,
4.20.20: paśya pāṇḍava me’vasthāṁ yathā nārhāmi vai tathā,
4.20.23: idaṁ tu duḥkhaṁ kaunteya mamāsahyaṁ nibodha tat,
yā na jātu svayaṁ piṁṣe gātrodvartanamātmanaḥ,
anyatra kuntyā bhadraṁ te sā pinaṣmyadya candanam ॥23॥
4.20.24: paśya kaunteya pāṇī me naivābhūtāṁ hi yau purā,
4.20.25: bibhemi kuntyā yā nāhaṁ yuṣmākaṁ vā kadācana,
4.20.26: kiṁ nu vakṣyati samrāṇmāṁ varṇakaḥ sukr̥to na vā,
nānyapiṣṭaṁ hi mansyasya candanaṁ kila rocate ॥26॥
4.20.28: sā bāṣpakalayā vācā niḥśvasantī punaḥ punaḥ,
4.20.29: nālpaṁ kr̥taṁ mayā bhīma devānāṁ kilbiṣaṁ purā,
abhāgyā yatra jīvāmi kartavye sati pāṇḍava ॥29॥
4.20.31: tau gr̥hītvā ca kaunteyo bāṣpamutsr̥jya vīryavān,
4.20.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi draupadībhīmasaṁvāde viṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥20॥
4.21.1: dhigastu me bāhubalaṁ gāṇḍīvaṁ phālgunasya ca,
yat te raktau purā bhūtvā pāṇī kr̥takiṇāvimau ॥1॥
4.21.2: sabhāyāṁ tu virāṭasya karomi kadanaṁ mahat,
tatra me kāraṇaṁ bhāti kaunteyo yat pratīkṣate ॥2॥
4.21.4: apaśyaṁ tvāṁ yadā kr̥ṣṇe kīcakena padā hatām,
4.21.5: tadahaṁ tasya vijñāya sthita evāsmi bhāmini ॥5॥
4.21.7: mā dharmaṁ jahi suśroṇi krodhaṁ jahi mahāmate ॥7॥
4.21.8: imaṁ tu samupālambhaṁ tvatto rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
śr̥ṇuyād vāpi kalyāṇi kr̥tsnaṁ jahyāt sa jīvitam ॥8॥
4.21.9: dhanañjayo vā suśroṇi yamau vā tanumadhyame,
4.21.10: purā sukanyā bhāryā ca bhārgavaṁ cyavanaṁ vane,
4.21.11: nārāyaṇī cendrasenā rūpeṇa yadi te śrutā,
4.21.12: duhitā janakasyāpi vaidehī yadi te śrutā,
4.21.13: rakṣasā nigrahaṁ prāpya rāmasya mahiṣī priyā,
4.21.16: tathā tvamapi kalyāṇi sarvaiḥ samuditā guṇaiḥ ॥16॥
4.21.17: mādīrghaṁ kṣama kālaṁ tvaṁ māsamardhaṁ ca sammitam,
pūrṇe trayodaśe varṣe rājñāṁ rājñī bhaviṣyasi ॥17॥
4.21.17d1: satyena te śape cāhaṁ bhavitā nānyatheti ha,
sarveṣāṁ ca narendrāṇāṁ mūrdhni sthāsyasi bhāmini.
4.21.17d2: bhartr̥bhaktyā ca vr̥ttena bhogān prāpsyasi durlabhān.
4.21.21: tasyā viditvā taṁ bhāvaṁ svayaṁ cānr̥tadarśanaḥ,
kīcako’yaṁ suduṣṭātmā sadā prārthayate hi mām ॥21॥
4.21.22: tamahaṁ kupitā bhīma punaḥ kopaṁ niyamya ca,
4.21.23: te tvāṁ nihanyuḥ kupitāḥ śūrāḥ sāhasakāriṇaḥ ॥23॥
4.21.25: samāgataṁ haniṣyāmi tvaṁ bhīru kuru me kṣaṇam ॥25॥
4.21.27: necchāmi kañcid vadhyantaṁ tena jīvasi kīcaka ॥27॥
4.21.28: evamuktaḥ sa duṣṭātmā prāhasat svanavat tadā,
atha māṁ tatra kaikeyī praiṣayat praṇayena tu ॥28॥
4.21.32: sandarśane tu māṁ rājñaḥ sūtaputraḥ parāmr̥śat,
pātayitvā tu duṣṭātmā padāhaṁ tena tāḍitā ॥32॥
4.21.33: prekṣate sma virāṭastu kaṅkastu bahavo janāḥ,
4.21.34: upālabdho mayā rājā kaṅkaścāpi punaḥ punaḥ,
tato na vārito rājñā na tasyāvinayaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥34॥
4.21.35: yo’yaṁ rājño virāṭastha kīcako nāma sārathiḥ,
4.21.37: na tiṣṭhati sma sanmārgeṁ na ca dharmaṁ bubhūṣati ॥37॥
4.21.39: darśane darśane hanyād yadi jahyāṁ ca jīvitam,
tad dharme yatamānānāṁ mahān dharmo naśiṣyati ॥39॥
4.21.40: samayaṁ rakṣamāṇānāṁ bhāryā vo na bhaviṣyati,
4.21.41: ātmā hi jāyate tasyāṁ tena jāyāṁ vidurbudhāḥ ॥41॥
4.21.42: bhartā tu bhāryayā rakṣyaḥ kathaṁ jāyānmamodare,
4.21.44: tava caiva samakṣe vai bhīmasena mahābala,
4.21.48: śreyo hi maraṇaṁ mahyaṁ bhīmasena tavāgrataḥ ॥48॥
4.21.49: bhīmaśca tāṁ pariṣvajya mahat sāntvaṁ prayujya ca ॥49॥
4.21.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi draupadīsāntvane ekaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥21॥
4.22.1: tathā bhadre kariṣyāmi yathā tvaṁ bhīru bhāṣase,
4.22.2: duḥkhaṁ śokaṁ ca nirdhūya yājñaseni śucismite ॥2॥
4.22.3: divātra kanyā nr̥tyanti rātrau yānti yathāgr̥ham ॥3॥
4.22.5: yathā ca tvāṁ na paśyeyuḥ kurvāṇāṁ tena saṁvidam,
kuryāstathā tvaṁ kalyāṇi yathā saṁnihito bhavet ॥5॥
4.22.6: tathā tau kathayitvā tu bāṣpamutsr̥jya duḥkhitau,
4.22.9: ahameva hi matsyānāṁ rājā vai vāhinīpatiḥ ॥9॥
4.22.10: māṁ sukhaṁ pratipadyasva dāso bhīru bhavāmi te,
ahnāya tava suśroṇi śataṁ niṣkān dadāmyaham ॥10॥
4.22.11: dāsīśataṁ ca te dadyāṁ dāsānāmapi cāparam,
4.22.12: evaṁ me samayaṁ tvadya pratipadyasva kīcaka,
na tvāṁ sakhā vā bhrātā vā jānīyāt saṅgataṁ mayā ॥12॥
4.22.13: evaṁ me pratijānīhi tato’haṁ vaśagā tava ॥13॥
4.22.16: divātra kanyā nr̥tyanti rātrau yānti yathāgr̥ham ॥16॥
4.22.17: tatra doṣaḥ parihr̥to bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥17॥
4.22.17d1: tathā bhadre kariṣyāmi yathā tvaṁ bhīru manyase,
4.22.17d2: samāgamārthaṁ suśroṇi śape ca sukr̥tena me,
4.22.17d3: satyaṁ te pratijānāmi gandharvebhyo na te bhayam,
4.22.21: tasya tat kurvataḥ karma kālo dīrgha ivābhavat,
4.22.24: tatastu draupadī gatvā tadā bhīmaṁ mahānase,
4.22.26: eko niśi mahābāho kīcakaṁ taṁ niṣūdaya ॥26॥
4.22.27: gatvā tvaṁ nartanāgāraṁ nirjīvaṁ kuru pāṇḍava ॥27॥
4.22.29: ātmanaścaiva bhadraṁ te kuru mānaṁ kulasya ca ॥29॥
4.22.30: svāgataṁ te varārohe yanmāṁ vedayase priyam,
4.22.32: satyaṁ bhrātr̥̄ṁśca dharmaṁ ca puraskr̥tya bravīmi te,
4.22.33: taṁ gahvare prakāśe vā pothayiṣyāmi kīcakam,
atha cedapi yotsyanti hiṁse matsyānapi dhruvam ॥33॥
4.22.35: yathā na santyajethāstvaṁ satyaṁ vai matkr̥te vibho,
nigūḍhastvaṁ tathā pārtha kīcakaṁ taṁ niṣūdaya ॥35॥
4.22.36: evametat kariṣyāmi yathā tvaṁ bhīru bhāṣase,
adya taṁ sūdayiṣyāmi kīcakaṁ saha bāndhavaiḥ ॥36॥
4.22.38: bhīmo’tha prathamaṁ gatvā rātrau channa upāviśat,
4.22.40: praviśya ca sa tad veśma tamasā saṁvr̥taṁ mahat ॥40॥
4.22.47: īdr̥śastu tvayā sparśaḥ spr̥ṣṭapūrvo na karhicit ॥47॥
4.22.50: adya tvāṁ bhaginī pāpaṁ kr̥ṣyamāṇaṁ mayā bhuvi,
4.22.52: sa keśeṣu parāmr̥ṣṭo balena balināṁ varaḥ ॥52॥
4.22.57: sthirapratijñaḥ sa raṇe padānna calitaḥ padam ॥57॥
4.22.61: sa cāpyenaṁ tadā bhīmaḥ pratijagrāha vīryavān,
4.22.64: bhīmena ca parāmr̥ṣṭo durbalo balinā raṇe,
4.22.69: talābhyāṁ sa tu bhīmena vakṣasyabhihato balī,
4.22.70: muhūrtaṁ tu sa taṁ vegaṁ sahitvā bhuvi duḥsaham,
4.22.72: jagrāha jayatāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ keśeṣveva tadā bhr̥śam ॥72॥
4.22.76: pragr̥hya tarasā dorbhyāṁ kaṇṭhaṁ tasya vr̥kodaraḥ,
4.22.81: samākramya ca saṅkruddho balena balināṁ varaḥ ॥81॥
4.22.82: tasya pādau ca pāṇī ca śiro grīvāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
4.22.84: uvāca ca mahātejā draupadīṁ yoṣitāṁ varām,
4.22.86: tato’gniṁ tatra prajvālya darśayitvā tu kīcakam,
pāñcālīṁ sa tadā vīra idaṁ vacanamabravīt ॥86॥
4.22.87: evaṁ te bhīru vadhyante kīcakaḥ śobhate yathā ॥87॥
4.22.88: tat kr̥tvā duṣkaraṁ karma kr̥ṣṇāyāḥ priyamuttamam,
tathā sa kīcakaṁ hatvā gatvā roṣasya vai śamam ॥88॥
4.22.89: kīcakaṁ ghātayitvā tu draupadī yoṣitāṁ varā,
4.22.92: tato gatvātha tad veśma kīcakaṁ vinipātitam,
4.22.94: amānuṣaṁ kr̥taṁ karma taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vinipātitam,
kvāsya grīvā kva caraṇau kva pāṇī kva śirastathā,
iti sma taṁ parīkṣante gandharveṇa hataṁ tadā ॥94॥
4.22.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi kīcakavadhe dvāviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥22॥
4.23.1: tasmin kāle samāgamya sarve tatrāsya bāndhavāḥ,
4.23.6: athavā naiva hantavyā dahyatāṁ kāminā saha,
4.23.9: momuhyamānāṁ te tatra jagr̥huḥ kīcakā bhr̥śam ॥9॥
4.23.10: tatastu tāṁ samāropya nibadhya ca sumadhyamām,
4.23.12: te me vācaṁ vijānantu sūtaputrā nayanti mām ॥12॥
4.23.14: te me vācaṁ vijānantu sūtaputrā nayanti mām ॥14॥
4.23.16: ahaṁ śr̥ṇomi te vācaṁ tvayā sairandhri bhāṣitām,
tasmāt te sūtaputrebhyo bhayaṁ bhīru na vidyate ॥16॥
4.23.17: tataḥ sa vyāyataṁ kr̥tvā veṣaṁ viparivartya ca ॥17॥
4.23.19: śmaśānābhimukhaḥ prāyād yatra te kīcakā gatāḥ,
sa laṅghayitvā prākāraṁ niḥsr̥tya ca purottamāt,
4.23.22: sa taṁ vr̥kṣaṁ daśavyāmaṁ saskandhaviṭapaṁ balī,
4.23.25: sairandhrī mucyatāṁ śīghraṁ yato no bhayamāgatam ॥25॥
4.23.26: te tu dr̥ṣṭvā tadā’’viddhaṁ bhīmasenena pādapam,
4.23.28: tata āśvāsayat kr̥ṣṇāṁ sa vimucya viśāmpate ॥28॥
4.23.29: uvāca ca mahābāhuḥ pāñcālīṁ tatra draupadīm,
4.23.30: evaṁ te bhīru vadhyante ye tvāṁ kliśyantyanāgasam,
praihi tvaṁ nagaraṁ kr̥ṣṇe na bhayaṁ vidyate tava ॥30॥
4.23.32: pañcādhikaṁ śataṁ tacca nihataṁ tena bhārata,
4.23.33: evaṁ te nihatā rājañchataṁ pañca ca kīcakāḥ,
4.23.34: tad dr̥ṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṁ narā nāryaśca saṅgatāḥ,
vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatvā nocuḥ kiñcana bhārata ॥34॥
4.24.1: te dr̥ṣṭvā nihatān sūtān rājñe gatvā nyavedayan,
4.24.2: yathā vajreṇa vai dīrṇaṁ parvatasya mahacchiraḥ,
4.24.3: sairandhrī ca vimuktāsau punarāyāti te gr̥ham,
sarvaṁ saṁśayitaṁ rājan nagaraṁ te bhaviṣyati ॥3॥
4.24.5: yathā sairandhridoṣeṇa na te rājannidaṁ puram,
4.24.6: teṣāṁ tad vacanaṁ śrutvā virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ,
4.24.9: gaccha sairandhri bhadraṁ te yathākāmaṁ varānane,
4.24.10: na hi tvāmutsahe vaktuṁ svayaṁ gandharvarakṣitām,
4.24.11: atha muktā bhayāt kr̥ṣṇā sūtaputrān nirasya ca,
4.24.12: gātrāṇi vāsasī caiva prakṣālya salilena sā ॥12॥
4.24.13: tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā puruṣā rājan prādravanta diśo daśa,
4.24.14: dadarśa rājan pāñcālī yathā mattaṁ mahādvipam ॥14॥
4.24.19: diṣṭyā vinihatāḥ sūtā ye tvāṁ kliśyantyanāgasam ॥19॥
4.24.20: kathaṁ sairandhri muktāsi kathaṁ pāpāśca te hatāḥ,
icchāmi vai tava śrotuṁ sarvameva yathātatham ॥20॥
4.24.21: br̥hannale kiṁ nu tava sairandhryā kāryamadya vai,
yā tvaṁ vasasi kalyāṇi sadā kanyāpure sukham ॥21॥
4.24.22: na hi duḥkhaṁ samāpnoṣi sairandhrī yadupāśnute,
4.24.24: tvayā sahoṣitā cāsmi tvaṁ ca sarvaiḥ sahoṣitā,
kliśyantyāṁ tvayi suśroṇi ko nu duḥkhaṁ na cintayet ॥24॥
4.24.25: vedituṁ śakyate nūnaṁ tena māṁ nāvabudhyase ॥25॥
4.24.27: sairandhri gamyatāṁ śīghraṁ yatra kāmayase gatim ॥27॥
4.24.28: rājā bibheti te bhadre gandharvebhyaḥ parābhavāt,
tvaṁ cāpi taruṇī subhru rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi,
4.24.30: tato māmupaneṣyanti kariṣyanti ca te priyam,
dhruvaṁ ca śreyasā rājā yokṣyate saha bāndhavaiḥ ॥30॥
4.24.30d2: arthinī prabravīmyeṣā yad vā tad veti cintaya,
4.24.30d4: vasa bhadre yatheṣṭaṁ tvaṁ tvāmahaṁ śaraṇaṁ gatā,
4.24.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi kīcakavadhaparvaṇi kīcakadāhe caturviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥24॥
4.25.0d1: kīcake tu hate rājā virāṭaḥ paravīrahā,
4.25.2: śauryāddhi vallabho rājño mahāsattvaḥ sa kīcakaḥ ॥2॥
4.25.3: āsīt prahartā sainyānāṁ dārāmarśī ca durmatiḥ,
4.25.5: atha vai dhārtarāṣṭreṇa prayuktā ye bahiścarāḥ,
mr̥gayitvā bahūn grāmān rāṣṭrāṇi nagarāṇi ca ॥5॥
4.25.6: kr̥takr̥tyā nyavartanta te carā nagaraṁ prati ॥6॥
4.25.7: tatra dr̥ṣṭvā tu rājānaṁ kauravyaṁ dhr̥tarāṣṭrajam,
4.25.11: na ca vidmo gatā yena pārthāḥ sudr̥ḍhavikramāḥ,
mārgamāṇāḥ padanyāsaṁ teṣu teṣu tathā tathā ॥11॥
4.25.13: atyantaṁ vā vinaṣṭāste bhadraṁ tubhyaṁ nararṣabha ॥13॥
4.25.14: na hi vidmo gatiṁ teṣāṁ vāsaṁ hi narasattama ॥14॥
4.25.16: prāptā dvāravatīṁ sūtā vinā pārthaiḥ parantapa,
na tatra kr̥ṣṇā rājendra pāṇḍavāśca mahāvratāḥ ॥16॥
4.25.17: na hi vidmo gatiṁ teṣāṁ vāsaṁ vāpi mahātmanām ॥17॥
4.25.18: pāṇḍavānāṁ pravr̥ttiṁ ca vidmaḥ karmāpi vā kr̥tam,
sa naḥ śādhi manuṣyendra ata ūrdhvaṁ viśāmpate ॥18॥
4.25.19: imāṁ ca naḥ priyāṁ vīra vācaṁ bhadravatīṁ śr̥ṇu ॥19॥
4.25.20: yena trigartā nihatā balena mahatā nr̥pa,
4.25.21: sa hataḥ patitaḥ śete gandharvairniśi bhārata,
4.25.21d1: sudeṣṇāyāḥ sa vai jyeṣṭhaḥ śūro vīro gatavyathaḥ.
4.25.21d4: sa hato niśi gandharvaiḥ strīnimittaṁ narādhipa,
4.25.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi cārapratyāgamane pañcaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥25॥
4.26.1: tato duryodhano rājā jñātvā teṣāṁ vacastadā,
4.26.2: tasmāt sarve nirīkṣadhvaṁ kva nu te pāṇḍavā gatāḥ ॥2॥
4.26.4: asya varṣasya śeṣaṁ ced vyatīyuriha pāṇḍavāḥ,
4.26.5: duḥkhā bhaveyuḥ saṁrabdhāḥ kauravān prati te dhruvam ॥5॥
4.26.8: athābravīt tataḥ karṇaḥ kṣipraṁ gacchantu bhārata,
anye dhūrtā narā dakṣā nibhr̥tāḥ sādhukāriṇaḥ ॥8॥
4.26.12: āśrameṣu ca ramyeṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca ॥12॥
4.26.14: te yāntu dattadeyā vai bhūyastān parimārgitum ॥14॥
4.26.15: etacca karṇo yat prāha sarvamīhāmahe tathā,
4.26.16: ete cānye ca bhūyāṁso deśād deśaṁ yathāvidhi,
4.26.17: atyantaṁ vā nigūḍhāste pāraṁ cormimato gatāḥ,
4.26.18: athavā viṣamaṁ prāpya vinaṣṭāḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ,
4.26.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi karṇaduḥśāsanavākye ṣaḍviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥26॥
4.27.1: na tādr̥śā vinaśyanti na prayānti parābhavam ॥1॥
4.27.5: kimarthaṁ nītimān pārthaḥ śreyo naiṣāṁ kariṣyati ॥5॥
4.27.6: na hi te nāśamr̥ccheyuriti paśyāmyahaṁ dhiyā ॥6॥
4.27.7: sāmprataṁ caiva yat kāryaṁ tacca kṣipramakālikam,
4.27.9: śuddhātmā guṇavān pārthaḥ satyavān nītimān śuciḥ,
4.27.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi droṇavākye cārapratyācāre saptaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥27॥
4.28.3: asatsu durlabhāṁ nityaṁ satāṁ cābhimatāṁ sadā ॥3॥
4.28.9: tatra buddhiṁ pravakṣyāmi pāṇḍavān prati bhārata,
na tu nītiḥ sunītasya śakyate’nveṣituṁ paraiḥ ॥9॥
4.28.10: yat tu śakyamihāsmābhistān vai sañcintya pāṇḍavān,
buddhyā prayuktaṁ na drohāt pravakṣyāmi nibodha tat ॥10॥
4.28.11: sā tviyaṁ sādhu vaktavyā na tvanītiḥ kathañcana ॥11॥
4.28.12: avaśyaṁ tviha dhīreṇa satāṁ madhye vivakṣatā ॥12॥
4.28.13: tatra nāhaṁ tathā manye yathāyamitaro janaḥ ॥13॥
4.28.14: tatra tāta na teṣāṁ hi rājñāṁ bhāvyamasāmpratam ॥14॥
4.28.15: pure janapade cāpi yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
jano janapade bhāvyo yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥15॥
4.28.16: priyavādī sadā dānto bhavyaḥ satyaparo janaḥ,
hr̥ṣṭaḥ puṣṭaḥ śucirdakṣo yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥16॥
4.28.19: sadā ca tatra parjanyaḥ samyagvarṣī na saṁśayaḥ,
4.28.20: guṇavanti ca dhānyāni rasavanti phalāni ca,
gandhavanti ca mālyāni śubhaśabdā ca bhāratī ॥20॥
4.28.21: na bhayaṁ tvāviśet tatra yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥21॥
4.28.22: gāvaśca bahulāstatra na kr̥śā na ca durbalāḥ,
4.28.23: guṇavanti ca peyāni bhojyāni rasavanti ca,
tatra deśe bhaviṣyanti yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥23॥
4.28.24: dr̥śyāni ca prasannāni yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥24॥
4.28.25: svaiḥ svairguṇaiśca saṁyuktā asmin varṣe trayodaśe ॥25॥
4.28.30: dharmātmā śakyate jñātuṁ nāpi tāta dvijātibhiḥ ॥30॥
4.28.31: kiṁ punaḥ prākr̥taistāta pārtho vijñāyate kvacit,
yasmin satyaṁ dhr̥tirdānaṁ parā śāntirdhruvā kṣamā ॥31॥
4.28.32: hrīḥ śrīḥ kīrtiḥ paraṁ teja ānr̥śaṁsyamathārjavam,
tasmāt tatra nivāsaṁ tu channaṁ yatnena dhīmataḥ,
gatiṁ ca paramāṁ tatra notsahe vaktumanyathā ॥32॥
4.28.33: evametat tu sañcintya yatkr̥te manyase hitam,
tat kṣipraṁ kuru kauravya yadyevaṁ śraddadhāsi me ॥33॥
4.28.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi cārapratyācāre bhīṣmavākye aṣṭāviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥28॥
4.29.1: yuktaṁ prāptaṁ ca vr̥ddhena pāṇḍavān prati bhāṣitam ॥1॥
4.29.3: nītirvidhīyatāṁ cāpi sāmprataṁ yā hitā bhavet ॥3॥
4.29.6: udayaḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ ca prāpte kāle na saṁśayaḥ ॥6॥
4.29.8: tasmād balaṁ ca koṣaśca nītiścāpi vidhīyatām,
yathā kālodaye prāpte samyak taiḥ sandadhāmahe ॥8॥
4.29.9: tāta buddhyāpi tat sarvaṁ budhyasva balamātmanaḥ,
4.29.10: uccāvacaṁ balaṁ jñātvā madhyasthaṁ cāpi bhārata,
4.29.12: sāntvayitvā tu mitrāṇi balaṁ cābhāṣyatāṁ sukham,
4.29.14d1: tato duryodhano vākyaṁ śrutvā teṣāṁ mahātmanām,
4.29.14d4: uttamāḥ prāṇināṁ teṣāṁ nāsti kaścid bale samaḥ.
4.29.14d9: sairandhrīṁ draupadīṁ manye nātra kāryā vicāraṇā,
4.29.14d10: ko hi śaktaḥ paro bhīmāt kīcakaṁ hantumojasā.
4.29.14d13: pitāmahena ye coktā deśasya ca janasya ca.
4.29.14d15: nivasanti pure ramye tatra yātrā vidhīyatām,
4.29.14d16: gr̥hīte godhane nūnaṁ te’pi yotsyanti pāṇḍavāḥ,
apūrṇe samaye cāpi yadi paśyema pāṇḍavān,
4.29.14d19: tasmāt kartavyametad vai tatra yātrā vidhīyatām,
etat sunītaṁ manye’haṁ sarveṣāṁ yadi rocate.
4.29.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi cārapratyācāre kr̥pavākye ekonatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥29॥
4.30.2: sūtenaiva ca matsyasya kīcakena punaḥ punaḥ ॥2॥
4.30.3: bādhito bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṁ balād balavatā vibho,
4.30.5: nihataḥ sa tu gandharvaiḥ pāpakarmā nr̥śaṁsavān ॥5॥
4.30.6: bhaviṣyati nirutsāho virāṭa iti me matiḥ ॥6॥
4.30.7: tatra yātrā mama matā yadi te rocate’nagha,
kauravāṇāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ karṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
4.30.8: etat prāptamahaṁ manye kāryamātyayikaṁ hi naḥ,
4.30.9: grāmān rāṣṭrāṇi vā tasya hariṣyāmo vibhāgaśaḥ ॥9॥
4.30.10: athavā gosahasrāṇi śubhāni ca bahūni ca,
4.30.13: taṁ vaśe nyāyataḥ kr̥tvā sukhaṁ vatsyāmahe vayam,
4.30.14: sūktaṁ suśarmaṇā vākyaṁ prāptakālaṁ hitaṁ ca naḥ ॥14॥
4.30.15d1: prājño vā kuruvr̥ddho’yaṁ sarveṣāṁ naḥ pitāmahaḥ.
4.30.16: manyante te yathā sarve tathā yātrā vidhīyatām ॥16॥
4.30.17: kiṁ ca naḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ kāryaṁ hīnārthabalapauruṣaiḥ ॥17॥
4.30.18: atyantaṁ vā praṇaṣṭāste prāptā vāpi yamakṣayam,
ādāsyāmo hi gāstasya vividhāni vasūni ca ॥18॥
4.30.19: tato duryodhano rājā vākyamādāya tasya tat,
4.30.20: saha vr̥ddhaistu sammantrya kṣipraṁ yojaya vāhinīm ॥20॥
4.30.21: suśarmā ca yathoddiṣṭaṁ deśaṁ yātu mahārathaḥ,
4.30.22: prāgeva hi susaṁvīto matsyasya viṣayaṁ prati,
4.30.23: kṣipraṁ gopān samāsādya gr̥hṇantu vipulaṁ dhanam ॥23॥
4.30.25: te sma gatvā yathoddiṣṭāṁ diśaṁ vahnermahīpate,
4.30.26: prati vairaṁ cikīrṣanto goṣu gr̥ddhā mahābalāḥ,
4.30.27: apare divase sarve rājan sambhūya kauravāḥ,
4.30.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi dakṣiṇagograhe suśarmābhiyāne triṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥30॥
4.31.2: vyatītaḥ samayaḥ samyag vasatāṁ vai purottame,
4.31.3: kīcake tu hate rājā virāṭaḥ paravīrahā,
4.31.4: suśarmaṇā gr̥hītaṁ tad godhanaṁ tarasā bahu ॥4॥
4.31.4d3: atha trigartā bahavaḥ parigr̥hya dhanaṁ bahu.
4.31.4d4: gopālān pratyayudhyanta raṇe kr̥tvā jaye dhr̥tim.
4.31.5: sa dr̥ṣṭvā matsyarājaṁ ca rathāt praskandya kuṇḍalī ॥5॥
4.31.9: tān parīpsasva rājendra mā neśuḥ paśavastava,
4.31.14: utsedhe yasya padmāni śataṁ saugandhikāni ca ॥14॥
4.31.20d3: naite na jātu yudhyeyurgavārthamiti me matiḥ.
4.31.22: kavacāni ca citrāṇi dr̥ḍhāni ca mr̥dūni ca ॥22॥
4.31.24: neme jātu na yudhyeranniti me dhīyate matiḥ,
4.31.25: sahadevāya rājñe ca bhīmāya nakulāya ca,
4.31.26: kavacāni vicitrāṇi mr̥dūni ca dr̥ḍhāni ca ॥26॥
4.31.30d1: dīrghāṇāṁ ca dr̥ḍhānāṁ ca dhanuṣāṁ te yathābalam,
4.31.35: samprayātaṁ tadā rājan nirīkṣantaṁ gavāṁ padam,
4.31.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi dakṣiṇagograhe matsyarājaraṇodyoge ekatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥31॥
4.32.6: udatiṣṭhad rajo bhaumaṁ na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥6॥
4.32.17d2: pakṣau yamau ca bhavataḥ pucchamāsīd vr̥kodaraḥ.
4.32.22: hayānāṁ ca śatānyaṣṭau hatvā pañca mahārathān ॥22॥
4.32.23: caran sa vividhān mārgān rathena rathasattamaḥ,
4.32.26: śarān vyasr̥jatāṁ śīghraṁ toyadhārā ghanā iva ॥26॥
4.32.28: tato rājā suśarmāṇaṁ vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
4.32.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi dakṣiṇagograhe virāṭasuśarmayuddhe dvātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥32॥
4.33.1: atiṣṭhan vai muhūrtaṁ tu vyūḍhānīkāḥ prahāriṇaḥ ॥1॥
4.33.2: kurvāṇo vimalāṁ rātriṁ nandayan kṣatriyān yudhi ॥2॥
4.33.4: tataḥ suśarmā traigartaḥ saha bhrātrā yavīyasā,
4.33.8: tau nihatya pr̥thag dhuryāvubhau tau pārṣṇisārathī,
4.33.12: taṁ mocaya mahābāho na gacched dviṣatāṁ vaśam ॥12॥
4.33.13: uṣitāḥ sma sukhaṁ sarve sarvakāmaiḥ supūjitāḥ,
bhīmasena tvayā kāryā tasya vāsasya niṣkr̥tiḥ ॥13॥
4.33.14: paśya me sumahat karma yudhyataḥ saha śatrubhiḥ ॥14॥
4.33.20: cāpaṁ vā yadi vā śaktiṁ nistriṁśaṁ vā paraśvadham,
4.33.21: yamau ca cakrarakṣau te bhavitārau mahābalau ॥21॥
4.33.23: gr̥hītvā tu dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṁ javena sumahājavaḥ,
4.33.27: rathānāṁ ca gajānāṁ ca vājināṁ ca sasādinām,
4.33.29: tad dr̥ṣṭvā tādr̥śaṁ yuddhaṁ suśarmā yuddhadurmadaḥ,
cintayāmāsa manasā kiṁ śeṣaṁ hi balasya me,
aparo dr̥śyate sainye purā magno mahābale ॥29॥
4.33.30: suśarmā sāyakāṁstīkṣṇān kṣipate ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥30॥
4.33.32: tān nivr̥ttarathān dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍavān sā mahācamūḥ,
4.33.36: hatvā tāṁ mahatīṁ senāṁ trigartānāṁ mahārathaḥ,
4.33.41: samāyād virathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā trigartaṁ prāharat tadā,
4.33.43: rājaputra nivartasva na te yuktaṁ palāyanam ॥43॥
4.33.44: anena vīryeṇa kathaṁ gāstvaṁ prārthayase balāt,
4.33.45: ityuktaḥ sa tu pārthena suśarmā rathayūthapaḥ,
tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti bhīmaṁ sa sahasā’bhyadravad balī ॥45॥
4.33.48: samudyamya tu roṣāt taṁ niṣpipeṣa mahītale ॥48॥
4.33.49: tasya jānuṁ dadau bhīmo jaghne cainamaratninā,
4.33.50: abhajyata balaṁ sarvaṁ traigartaṁ tad bhayāturam ॥50॥
4.33.53: sthitāḥ samakṣaṁ te sarve tvatha bhīmo’bhyabhāṣata ॥53॥
4.33.54: kiṁ tu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ yad rājā satataṁ ghr̥ṇī ॥54॥
4.33.55: tata enaṁ viceṣṭantaṁ baddhvā pārtho vr̥kodaraḥ ॥55॥
4.33.58: taṁ rājā prāhasad dr̥ṣṭvā mucyatāṁ vai narādhamaḥ,
4.33.59: jīvituṁ cecchase mūḍha hetuṁ me gadataḥ śr̥ṇu,
dāso’smīti tvayā vācyaṁ saṁsatsu ca sabhāsu ca ॥59॥
4.33.60: evaṁ te jīvitaṁ dadyāmeṣa yuddhajito vidhiḥ,
tamuvāca tato jyeṣṭho bhrātā sapraṇayaṁ vacaḥ ॥60॥
4.33.61: muñca muñcādhamācāraṁ pramāṇaṁ yadi te vayam,
adāso gaccha mukto’si maivaṁ kārṣīḥ kadācana ॥61॥
4.33.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi dakṣiṇagograhe trayastriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥33॥
4.34.4: yathaiva mama ratnāni yuṣmākaṁ tāni vai tathā,
kāryaṁ kuruta vai sarve yathākāmaṁ yathāsukham ॥4॥
4.34.6: tasmād bhavanto matsyānāmīśvarāḥ sarva eva hi ॥6॥
4.34.8: pratinandāma te vākyaṁ sarvaṁ caiva viśāmpate,
etenaiva pratītāḥ sma yat tvaṁ mukto’dya śatrubhiḥ ॥8॥
4.34.11: tat te’haṁ sampradāsyāmi sarvamarhati no bhavān ॥11॥
4.34.12: ratnāni gāḥ suvarṇaṁ ca maṇimuktamathāpi ca,
4.34.13: tvatkr̥te hyadya paśyāmi rājyaṁ santānameva ca,
yataśca jātasaṁrambho na ca śatruvaśaṁ gataḥ ॥13॥
4.34.14: pratinandāmi te vākyaṁ manojñaṁ matsya bhāṣase ॥14॥
4.34.15d2: varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣya bhadraṁ te brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te.
4.34.15d4: etāni ca mama prītyā pratigr̥hṇīṣva suvrata.
4.34.15d5: ekaiva tu mama prītiryat tvaṁ mukto’si śatrubhiḥ,
4.34.15d6: dāraiḥ putraiśca saṁśliṣya sā hi prītirmamātulā,
4.34.16: suhr̥dāṁ priyamākhyātuṁ ghoṣayantu ca te jayam,
4.34.18: etāṁ cājñāṁ tataḥ śrutvā rājñā matsyena noditāḥ,
4.34.19: te gatvā tatra tāṁ rātrimatha sūryodayaṁ prati,
4.34.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi dakṣiṇagograhe virāṭajayaghoṣe catustriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥34॥
4.35.1: yāte trigartān matsye tu paśūṁstān vai parīpsati,
4.35.5: ṣaṣṭiṁ gavāṁ sahasrāṇi kuravaḥ kālayanti ca,
4.35.8: sa praviśya puraṁ rājño nr̥paveśmābhyayāt tataḥ,
4.35.9: dr̥ṣṭvā bhūmiñjayaṁ nāma putraṁ matsyasya māninam,
4.35.10: ṣaṣṭiṁ gavāṁ sahasrāṇi kuravaḥ kālayanti te,
4.35.11: rājaputra hitaprepsuḥ kṣipraṁ niryāhi ca svayam,
4.35.12: tvayā pariṣado madhye ślāghate sa narādhipaḥ,
4.35.13: iṣvastre nipuṇo yodhaḥ sadā vīraśca me sutaḥ,
4.35.14: āvartaya kurūn jitvā paśūn paśumatāṁ vara,
4.35.17: śvetā rajatasaṅkāśā rathe yujyantu te hayāḥ,
dhvajaṁ ca siṁhaṁ sauvarṇamucchrayantu tava prabho ॥17॥
4.35.19: yaśo mahadavāpya tvaṁ praviśedaṁ puraṁ punaḥ ॥19॥
4.35.20: tvaṁ hi rāṣṭrasya paramā gatirmatsyapateḥ sutaḥ,
4.35.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe gopavākye pañcatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥35॥
4.36.1: yadi me sārathiḥ kaścid bhavedaśveṣu kovidaḥ ॥1॥
4.36.2: taṁ tvahaṁ nāgavacchāmi yo me yantā bhavennaraḥ,
paśyadhvaṁ sārathiṁ kṣipraṁ mama yuktaṁ prayāsyataḥ ॥2॥
4.36.3: yat tadāsīnmahad yuddhaṁ tatra me sārathirhataḥ ॥3॥
4.36.4: sa labheyaṁ yadā tvanyaṁ hayayānavidaṁ naram,
4.36.6: droṇaṁ ca saha putreṇa maheṣvāsān samāgatān ॥6॥
4.36.8: kiṁ nu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ yadahaṁ tatra nābhavam ॥8॥
4.36.10: śrutvā tadarjuno vākyaṁ rājñaḥ putrasya bhāṣataḥ,
4.36.13: ayaṁ vai pāṇḍavasyāsīt sārathiḥ sammato dr̥ḍhaḥ,
mahāyuddheṣu saṁsiddhaḥ sa te yantā bhaviṣyati ॥13॥
4.36.14: tasya tad vacanaṁ strīṣu bhāṣataśca punaḥ punaḥ,
4.36.17: dr̥ṣṭapūrvo mayā vīra carantyā pāṇḍavān prati ॥17॥
4.36.18: yadā tat pāvako dāvamadahat khāṇḍavaṁ mahat,
4.36.19: ajayat khāṇḍavaprasthe na hi yantāsti tādr̥śaḥ ॥19॥
4.36.20: vaktuṁ svayaṁ yaccha hayān mameti vai ॥20॥
4.36.21: yeyaṁ kumārī suśroṇī bhaginī te yavīyasī,
asyāḥ sa vīra vacanaṁ kariṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥21॥
4.36.22: yadi vai sārathiḥ sa syāt kurūn sarvān na saṁśayaḥ,
4.36.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe br̥hannalāsārathyakathane ṣaṭtriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥36॥
4.37.5: kiṁ te mukhaṁ sundari na prasanna-
4.37.6: sa tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā viśālākṣīṁ rājaputrīṁ sakhīṁ tathā,
4.37.7: praṇayaṁ bhāvayantī sā sakhīmadhya idaṁ vacaḥ ॥7॥
4.37.8: gāvo rāṣṭrasya kurubhiḥ kālyante no br̥hannale,
tā vijetuṁ mama bhrātā prayāsyati dhanurdharaḥ ॥8॥
4.37.9: tena nāsti samaḥ sūto yo’sya sārathyamācaret ॥9॥
4.37.12: sā sārathyaṁ mama bhrātuḥ kuru sādhu br̥hannale,
purā dūrataraṁ gāvo hriyanta kurubhirhi naḥ ॥12॥
4.37.13: athaitad vacanaṁ me’dya niyuktā na kariṣyasi,
4.37.17: sairandhrī tvāṁ samācaṣṭe sā hi jānāti pāṇḍavān ॥17॥
4.37.21: gītaṁ vā yadi vā nr̥tyaṁ vāditraṁ vā pr̥thagvidham,
tat kariṣyāmi bhadraṁ te sārathyaṁ tu kuto mama ॥21॥
4.37.22: br̥hannale gāyano vā nartano vā punarbhava,
4.37.27: dhanūṁṣi ca mahārhāṇi bāṇāṁśca rucirān bahūn,
4.37.29: pāñcālikārthaṁ citrāṇi sūkṣmāṇi ca mr̥dūni ca,
4.37.30: evaṁ tā bruvatīḥ kanyāḥ sahitāḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ,
4.37.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe uttaraniryāṇaṁ nāma saptatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥37॥
4.38.1: prayāhītyabravīt sūtaṁ yatra te kuravo gatāḥ ॥1॥
4.38.10: notsahe kurubhiryoddhuṁ romaharṣaṁ hi paśya me,
4.38.12: dr̥ṣṭvaiva hi parānājau manaḥ pravyathatīva me ॥12॥
4.38.13: yatra droṇaśca bhīṣmaśca kr̥paḥ karṇo viviṁśatiḥ,
4.38.14: duryodhanastathā vīro rājā ca rathināṁ varaḥ,
4.38.15: hr̥ṣitāni ca romāṇi kaśmalaṁ cāgataṁ mama ॥15॥
4.38.17: trigartān me pitā yātaḥ śūnye sampraṇidhāya mām,
sarvāṁ senāmupādāya na me santīha sainikāḥ ॥17॥
4.38.19: na ca tāvat kr̥taṁ karma paraiḥ kiñcid raṇājire ॥19॥
4.38.20: svayameva ca māmāttha vaha māṁ kauravān prati,
so’haṁ tvāṁ tatra neṣyāmi yatraite bahulā dhvajāḥ ॥20॥
4.38.22: tathā strīṣu pratiśrutya pauruṣaṁ puruṣeṣu ca,
4.38.23: na ced vijitya gāstāstvaṁ gr̥hān vai pratiyāsyasi,
4.38.24: na ca śakṣyāmyanirjitya gāḥ prayātuṁ puraṁ prati ॥24॥
4.38.25: stotreṇa caiva sairandhryāstava vākyena tena ca,
kathaṁ na yudhyeyamahaṁ kurūn sarvān sthiro bhava ॥25॥
4.38.26: kāmaṁ harantu matsyānāṁ bhūyāṁsaḥ kuravo dhanam,
prahasantu ca māṁ nāryo narā vāpi br̥hannale ॥26॥
4.38.27: saṅgrāme na ca kāryaṁ me gāvo gacchantu cāpi me,
śūnyaṁ me nagaraṁ cāpi pituścaiva bibhemyaham ॥27॥
4.38.28: ityuktvā prādravad bhīto rathāt praskandya kuṇḍalī,
tyaktvā mānaṁ ca darpaṁ ca visr̥jya saśaraṁ dhanuḥ ॥28॥
4.38.29: naiṣa śūraiḥ smr̥to dharmaḥ kṣatriyasya palāyanam,
śreyastu maraṇaṁ yuddhe na bhītasya palāyanam ॥29॥
4.38.31: dīrghāṁ veṇīṁ vidhunvānaḥ sādhu rakte ca vāsasī,
4.38.33: kiñcidasya yathā puṁsaḥ kiñcidasya yathā striyaḥ ॥33॥
4.38.36: ekaḥ putro virāṭasya śūnye saṁnihitaḥ pure,
sa eṣa kila niryāto bālabhāvānna pauruṣāt ॥36॥
4.38.37: satreṇa nūnaṁ channaṁ hi carantaṁ pārthamarjunam,
uttaraḥ sārathiṁ kr̥tvā niryāto nagarād bahiḥ ॥37॥
4.38.38: sa no manyāmahe dr̥ṣṭvā bhīta eṣa palāyate,
4.38.39: iti sma kuravaḥ sarve vimr̥śantaḥ pr̥thak pr̥thak,
na ca vyavasituṁ kiñciduttaraṁ śaknuvanti te ॥39॥
4.38.40: channaṁ tathā taṁ satreṇa pāṇḍavaṁ prekṣya bhārata,
4.38.40d2: arjuno vāsudevo vā rāmaḥ pradyumna eva vā,
te hi naḥ pratisaṁyātuṁ saṅgrāme na ca śaknuyuḥ.
4.38.40d3: anyo vā klībarūpeṇa yadyāgacched gavāṁ padam,
4.38.40d4: arjuno neti cetyenaṁ na vyavasyanti te punaḥ,
iti sma kuravaḥ sarve mantrayanto mahārathāḥ.
4.38.40d5: adyāgacchati ye yoddhuṁ sarvaṁ saṁśayitaṁ balam.
4.38.40d6: na cāpyanyaṁ naraṁ tatra vyavasyanti dhanañjayāt,
4.38.42: nivartaya rathaṁ kṣipraṁ jīvan bhadrāṇi paśyati ॥42॥
4.38.43: śātakumbhasya śuddhasya śataṁ niṣkān dadāmi te,
4.38.44: mattāṁśca daśa mātaṅgān muñca māṁ tvaṁ br̥hannale ॥44॥
4.38.46: ehi me tvaṁ hayān yaccha yudhyamānasya śatrubhiḥ ॥46॥
4.38.49: ahaṁ vai kurubhiryotsye vijeṣyāmi ca te paśūn,
4.38.50: yantā bhava naraśreṣṭha yotsye’haṁ kurubhiḥ saha,
4.38.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe uttarāśvāsane aṣṭātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥38॥
4.39.5: niḥsaranti ca kośebhyaḥ śastrāṇi vividhāni ca ॥5॥
4.39.8: vaiśasaṁ ca pratīkṣadhvaṁ rakṣadhvaṁ cāpi godhanam ॥8॥
4.39.10: jitvā’va yaṁ neṣyati cādya gā vaḥ ॥10॥
4.39.11: sa eṣa pārtho vikrāntaḥ savyasācī parantapaḥ,
4.39.14: na cārjunaḥ kalāpūrṇo mama duryodhanasya ca ॥14॥
4.39.15: yadyeṣa pārtho rādheya kr̥taṁ kāryaṁ bhavenmama,
4.39.17: tasmin bruvati tad vākyaṁ dhārtarāṣṭre parantapa,
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥po drauṇiḥ pauruṣaṁ tadapūjayan ॥17॥
4.39.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe arjunapraśaṁsāyāmekonacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥39॥
4.40.2: nemāni hi tvadīyāni soḍhuṁ śakṣyanti me balam,
bhāraṁ cāpi guruṁ voḍhuṁ kuñjaraṁ vā pramarditum ॥2॥
4.40.3d1: naibhiḥ kāmamalaṁ kartuṁ karma vaijayikaṁ tviha,
atisūkṣmāṇi hrasvāni sarvāṇi ca mr̥dūni ca,
4.40.5: dhvajāḥ śarāśca śūrāṇāṁ divyāni kavacāni ca,
4.40.8: alaṁ bhāraṁ guruṁ voḍhuṁ dāruṇaṁ cārudarśanam,
4.40.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe arjunāstrakathane catvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥40॥
4.41.1: tadahaṁ rājaputraḥ san spr̥śeyaṁ pāṇinā katham ॥1॥
4.41.3: kathaṁ vā vyavahāryaṁ vai kurvīthāstvaṁ br̥hannale ॥3॥
4.41.4: dhanūṁṣyetāni mā bhaistvaṁ śarīraṁ nātra vidyate ॥4॥
4.41.5: tvāṁ kathaṁ ninditaṁ karma kārayeyaṁ nr̥pātmaja ॥5॥
4.41.6: evamuktaḥ sa pārthena rathāt praskandya kuṇḍalī,
4.41.12: saṁspr̥śya tāni cāpāni bhānumanti br̥hanti ca,
4.41.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe astrāvaropaṇe ekacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥41॥
4.42.2: vāraṇā yatra sauvarṇāḥ pr̥ṣṭhe bhāsanti daṁśitāḥ,
4.42.4: sūryā yatra ca sauvarṇāstrayo bhāsanti daṁśitāḥ,
4.42.6: ime ca kasya nārācāḥ sāhasrā lomavāhinaḥ,
4.42.13: kasyāyaṁ vimalaḥ khaḍgo gavye kośe samarpitaḥ ॥13॥
4.42.18: vismayo me paro jāto dr̥ṣṭvā sarvamidaṁ mahat ॥18॥
4.42.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaravākyaṁ nāma dvicatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥42॥
4.43.3: yena devān manuṣyāṁśca pārtho vijayate mr̥dhe ॥3॥
4.43.6: trīṇi pañcaśataṁ caiva śakro’śīti ca pañca ca,
somaḥ pañcaśataṁ rājā tathaiva varuṇaḥ śatam,
pārthaḥ pañca ca ṣaṣṭiṁ ca varṣāṇi śvetavāhanaḥ ॥6॥
4.43.8: yena pārtho’jayat kr̥tsnāṁ diśaṁ prācīṁ parantapaḥ ॥8॥
4.43.18: ye tvime niśitāḥ pītāḥ pr̥thavo dīrghavāsasaḥ,
4.43.23: yastvayaṁ vipulaḥ khaḍgo gavye kośe samarpitaḥ,
4.43.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe āyudhavarṇanaṁ nāma tricatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥43॥
4.44.2: kva nu svidarjunaḥ pārthaḥ kauravyo vā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
4.44.4: draupadī kva ca pāñcālī strīratnamiti viśrutā,
4.44.6: sairandhrīṁ draupadīṁ viddhi yatkr̥te kīcakā hatāḥ ॥6॥
4.44.7: daśa pārthasya nāmāni yāni pūrvaṁ śrutāni me,
prabrūyāstāni yadi me śraddadhyāṁ sarvameva te ॥7॥
4.44.8: hanta te’haṁ samācakṣe daśa nāmāni yāni me,
vairāṭe śr̥ṇu tāni tvaṁ yāni pūrvaṁ śrutāni te ॥8॥
4.44.10: kirīṭī nāma kenāsi savyasācī kathaṁ bhavān ॥10॥
4.44.11: arjunaḥ phālguno jiṣṇuḥ kr̥ṣṇo bībhatsureva ca,
4.44.12: śrutā me tasya vīrasya kevalā nāmahetavaḥ,
tat sarvaṁ yadi me brūyāḥ śraddadhyāṁ sarvameva te ॥12॥
4.44.14: nājitvā vinivartāmi tena māṁ vijayaṁ viduḥ ॥14॥
4.44.15: śvetāḥ kāñcanasaṁnāhā rathe yujyanti me hayāḥ,
4.44.16: jāto himavataḥ pr̥ṣṭhe tena māṁ phālgunaṁ viduḥ ॥16॥
4.44.17: purā śakreṇa me dattaṁ yudhyato dānavarṣabhaiḥ,
4.44.18: na kuryāṁ karma bībhatsaṁ yudhyamānaḥ kathañcana,
4.44.19: ubhau me dakṣiṇau pāṇī gāṇḍīvasya vikarṣaṇe,
4.44.20: pr̥thivyāṁ caturantāyāṁ varṇo me durlabhaḥ samaḥ,
karomi karma śuklaṁ ca tasmānmāmarjunaṁ viduḥ ॥20॥
4.44.22: kr̥ṣṇa ityeva daśamaṁ nāma cakre pitā mama,
4.44.24: diṣṭyā tvāṁ pārtha paśyāmi svāgataṁ te dhanañjaya,
4.44.25: yatastvayā kr̥taṁ pūrvaṁ citraṁ karma suduṣkaram,
ato bhayaṁ vyatītaṁ me prītiśca paramā tvayi ॥25॥
4.44.25d1: yā pratijñā kr̥tā pūrvaṁ tava sārathyakarmaṇi.
4.44.25d2: manaḥ svāsthyaṁ ca me jātaṁ jātaṁ bhāgyaṁ ca me mahat,
4.44.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe arjunaparicaye catuścatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥44॥
4.45.1: āsthāya ruciraṁ vīra rathaṁ sārathinā mayā,
4.45.2: prīto’smi puruṣavyāghra na bhayaṁ vidyate tava,
sarvān nudāmi te śatrūn raṇe raṇaviśārada ॥2॥
4.45.3: svastho bhava mahābāho paśya māṁ śatrubhiḥ saha,
4.45.4: etān sarvānupāsaṅgān kṣipraṁ badhnīhi me rathe,
4.45.8: nagaraṁ te mayā guptaṁ rathopasthaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥8॥
4.45.9: ajeyaḥ śatrusainyānāṁ vairāṭe vyetu te bhayam ॥9॥
4.45.10: bibhemi nāhameteṣāṁ jānāmi tvāṁ sthiraṁ yudhi,
4.45.11: niścayaṁ cāpi durmedhā na gacchāmi kathañcana ॥11॥
4.45.13d4: sā ca māmaśapat kruddhā śikhaṇḍī tvaṁ bhaveriti.
4.45.13d5: śrutvā tamindro māmāha mā bhaistvaṁ pārtha ṣaṇḍhataḥ,
4.45.14: carāmi vratacaryaṁ ca satyametad bravīmi te ॥14॥
4.45.16: paramo’nugraho me’dya yatastarko na me vr̥thā,
na hīdr̥śāḥ klībarūpā bhavanti tu narottama ॥16॥
4.45.17: sādhvasaṁ hi praṇaṣṭaṁ me kiṁ karomi bravīhi me ॥17॥
4.45.19: tathā māṁ viddhi sārathye śikṣitaṁ narapuṅgava ॥19॥
4.45.20: yasya yāte na paśyanti bhūmau kṣiptaṁ padaṁ padam,
dakṣiṇāṁ yo dhuraṁ yuktaḥ sugrīvasadr̥śo hayaḥ ॥20॥
4.45.21: yo’yaṁ dhuraṁ dhuryavaro vāmāṁ vahati śobhanaḥ,
taṁ manye meghapuṣpasya javena sadr̥śaṁ hayam ॥21॥
4.45.22: samaṁ śaibyasya taṁ manye javena balavattaram ॥22॥
4.45.23: yo’yaṁ vahati me pārṣṇiṁ dakṣiṇāmabhitaḥ sthitaḥ,
4.45.24: tvaṁ cemaṁ rathamāsthāya yoddhumarho mato mama ॥24॥
4.45.25: tato vimucya bāhubhyāṁ valayāni sa vīryavān,
4.45.28: praṇipatya tataḥ pārthaḥ samālabhya ca pāṇinā,
4.45.29: adhijyaṁ tarasā kr̥tvā gāṇḍīvaṁ vyākṣipad dhanuḥ ॥29॥
4.45.31: sa nirghāto’bhavad bhūbhid dikṣu vāyurvavau bhr̥śam,
papāta mahatī colkā diśo na pracakāśire,
4.45.35: uvāca pārtho mā bhaiṣīḥ prahasya svanavat tadā ॥35॥
4.45.39: svayaṁvare tu pāñcālyā rājabhiḥ saha saṁyuge,
4.45.40: upajīvya guruṁ droṇaṁ śakraṁ vaiśravaṇaṁ yamam,
varuṇaṁ pāvakaṁ caiva kr̥paṁ kr̥ṣṇaṁ ca mādhavam ॥40॥
4.45.41: rathaṁ vāhaya me śīghraṁ vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥41॥
4.45.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe uttarārjunayorvākyaṁ nāma pañcacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥45॥
4.46.1: uttaraṁ sārathiṁ kr̥tvā śamīṁ kr̥tvā pradakṣiṇam,
4.46.3: daivīṁ māyāṁ rathe yuktāṁ vihitāṁ viśvakarmaṇā,
4.46.4: sa ca taccintitaṁ jñātvā dhvaje bhūtānyadeśayat ॥4॥
4.46.5: khāt papāta rathe tūrṇaṁ divyarūpaṁ manoramam ॥5॥
4.46.6: rathaṁ tamāgataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā dakṣiṇaṁ prākarot tadā,
4.46.8d2: tasya śaṅkhasya śabdena dhanuṣo nisvanena ca,
4.46.10: saṁsthāpya cāśvān kaunteyaḥ samudyamya ca raśmibhiḥ,
4.46.15: naivaṁvidhaḥ śaṅkhaśabdaḥ purā jātu mayā śrutaḥ,
dhvajasya cāpi rūpaṁ me dr̥ṣṭapūrvaṁ na hīdr̥śam ॥15॥
4.46.16: dhanuṣaścaiva nirghoṣaḥ śrutapūrvo na me kvacit,
asya śaṅkhasya śabdena dhanuṣo niḥsvanena ca ॥16॥
4.46.17: rathasya ca ninādena mano muhyati me bhr̥śam ॥17॥
4.46.18: vyākulāśca diśaḥ sarvā hr̥dayaṁ vyathatīva me,
dhvajena pihitāḥ sarvā diśo na pratibhānti me ॥18॥
4.46.19: gāṇḍīvasya ca śabdena karṇau me badhirīkr̥tau,
sa muhūrtaṁ prayātaṁ tu pārtho vairāṭimabravīt ॥19॥
4.46.20: dr̥ḍhaṁ ca raśmīn saṁyaccha śaṅkhaṁ dhmāsyāmyahaṁ punaḥ ॥20॥
4.46.21: guhā girīṇāṁ ca tadā diśaḥ śailāṁstathaiva ca,
4.46.24: yathā rathasya nirghoṣo yathā megha udīryate,
4.46.26: pratyādityaṁ ca naḥ sarve mr̥gā ghorapravādinaḥ,
4.46.32: parābhūtā ca vaḥ senā na kaścid yoddhumicchati ॥32॥
4.46.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe autpātiko nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥46॥
4.47.1: droṇaṁ ca rathaśārdūlaṁ kr̥paṁ ca sumahāratham ॥1॥
4.47.2: punareva pravakṣyāmi na hi tr̥pyāmi taṁ bruvan ॥2॥
4.47.3: vane janapade jñātaireṣa eva paṇo hi naḥ ॥3॥
4.47.4: teṣāṁ na tāvannirvr̥ttaṁ vartate tu trayodaśam,
4.47.6: lobhād vā te na jānīyurasmān vā moha āviśat,
4.47.7: arthānāṁ ca punardvaidhe nityaṁ bhavati saṁśayaḥ,
4.47.11: imā gāvo grahītavyā gate matsye gavāṁ padam ॥11॥
4.47.12: te vā gāścānayiṣyanti yadi vā syuḥ parājitāḥ,
4.47.14: asmān jetumihāyāto matsyo vāpi svayaṁ bhavet ॥14॥
4.47.16: atha kasmāt sthitā hyete ratheṣu rathasattamāḥ,
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥paścaiva vikarṇo drauṇireva ca ॥16॥
4.47.18: yamena vāpi saṅgrāme ko hāstinapuraṁ vrajet ॥18॥
4.47.19: ko hi jīvet padātīnāṁ bhavedaśveṣu saṁśayaḥ ॥19॥
4.47.22: yathā senā na bhajyeta tathā nītirvidhīyatām ॥22॥
4.47.23: yathā na vibhramet senā tathā nītirvidhīyatām ॥23॥
4.47.25: aśvānāṁ hreṣitaṁ śrutvā kaḥ praśaṁsāparo bhavet,
sthāne vāpi vrajanto vā sadā hreṣanti vājinaḥ ॥25॥
4.47.26: sadā ca vāyavo vānti nityaṁ varṣati vāsavaḥ,
4.47.27: kimatra kāryaṁ pārthasya kathaṁ vā sa praśasyate,
anyatra kāmād dveṣād vā roṣādasmāsu kevalāt ॥27॥
4.47.33: vidhīyatāṁ tathā nītiryathā vadhyo bhavet paraḥ ॥33॥
4.47.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe duryodhanavākye saptacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥47॥
4.48.4: chādayantu śarāḥ pārthaṁ śalabhā iva pādapam ॥4॥
4.48.6: samāhito hi bībhatsurvarṣāṇyaṣṭau ca pañca ca,
4.48.19: adyaiva patatāṁ bhūmau vinadan bhairavān ravān ॥19॥
4.48.23: ratheṣu vāpi tiṣṭhanto yuddhaṁ paśyantu māmakam ॥23॥
4.48.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe karṇavikatthane aṣṭacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥48॥
4.49.1: sadaiva tava rādheya yuddhe krūratarā matiḥ,
4.49.2: māyā hi bahavaḥ santi śāstramāśritya cintitāḥ,
teṣāṁ yuddhaṁ tu pāpiṣṭhaṁ vedayanti purāvidaḥ ॥2॥
4.49.3: hīnakālaṁ tadeveha phalaṁ na labhate punaḥ,
deśe kāle ca vikrāntaṁ kalyāṇāya vidhīyate ॥3॥
4.49.4: bhāraṁ hi rathakārasya na vyavasyanti paṇḍitāḥ ॥4॥
4.49.5: paricintya tu pārthena saṁnipātoṁ na naḥ kṣamaḥ,
4.49.9: vijigye tarasā saṅkhye senāṁ prāpya sudurjayām ॥9॥
4.49.11: ekena hi tvayā karṇa kiṁ nāmeha kr̥taṁ purā,
ekaikena yathā teṣāṁ bhūmipālā vaśe kr̥tāḥ ॥11॥
4.49.12: indro’pi hi na pārthena saṁyuge yoddhumarhati,
4.49.14: athavā kuñjaraṁ mattameka eva caran vane,
4.49.16: ātmānaṁ kaḥ samudbaddhya kaṇṭhe baddhvā mahāśilām,
samudraṁ tarate dorbhyāṁ tatra kiṁ nāma pauruṣam ॥16॥
4.49.17: tādr̥śaṁ karṇa yaḥ pārthaṁ yoddhumicchet sa durmatiḥ ॥17॥
4.49.18: siṁhaḥ pāśavinirmukto na naḥ śeṣaṁ kariṣyati ॥18॥
4.49.21: droṇo duryodhano bhīṣmo bhavān drauṇistathā vayam,
sarve yudhyāmahe pārthaṁ karṇa mā sāhasaṁ kr̥thāḥ ॥21॥
4.49.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe kr̥pavākyaṁ nāma ekonapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥49॥
4.50.1: na ca tāvajjitā gāvo na ca sīmāntaraṁ gatāḥ,
na hāstinapuraṁ prāptāstvaṁ ca karṇa vikatthase ॥1॥
4.50.2: saṅgrāmāṁśca bahūn jitvā labdhavā ca vipulaṁ dhanam,
vijitya ca parāṁ senāṁ nāhuḥ kiñcana pauruṣam ॥2॥
4.50.4: dhanaṁ yairadhigantavyaṁ yacca kurvan na duṣyati ॥4॥
4.50.5: adhītya brāhmaṇo vedān yājayeta yajeta vā,
4.50.6: śūdraḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṁ kuryāt triṣu varṇeṣu nityaśaḥ,
4.50.10: nakulaṁ sahadevaṁ vā dhanaṁ yeṣāṁ tvayā hr̥tam ॥10॥
4.50.11: yudhiṣṭhiro jitaḥ kasmin bhīmaśca balināṁ varaḥ,
indraprasthaṁ tvayā kasmin saṅgrāme nirjitaṁ purā ॥11॥
4.50.12: tathaiva katamad yuddhaṁ yasmin kr̥ṣṇā jitā tvayā,
4.50.13: mūlameṣāṁ mahat kr̥ttaṁ sārārthī candanaṁ yathā,
karma kārayithāḥ sūta tatra kiṁ viduro’bravīt ॥13॥
4.50.15: tvaṁ punaḥ paṇḍito bhūtvā vācaṁ vaktumihecchasi ॥15॥
4.50.17: naiṣa devān na gandharvān nāsurān na ca rākṣasān,
4.50.19: vāsudevasamaṁ yuddhe taṁ pārthaṁ ko na pūjayet ॥19॥
4.50.20: devaṁ daivena yudhyeta mānuṣeṇa ca mānuṣam,
astraṁ hyastreṇa yo hanyāt ko’rjunena samaḥ pumān ॥20॥
4.50.22: yathā’’naiṣīḥ sabhāṁ kr̥ṣṇāṁ tathā yudhyasva pāṇḍavam ॥22॥
4.50.23: ayaṁ te mātulaḥ prājñaḥ kṣatradharmasya kovidaḥ,
4.50.24: nākṣān kṣipati gāṇḍīvaṁ na kr̥taṁ dvāparaṁ na ca,
4.50.26: kuryurete kvaciccheṣaṁ na tu kruddho dhanañjayaḥ ॥26॥
4.50.27: yathā sabhāyāṁ dyūtaṁ tvaṁ mātulena sahākaroḥ,
4.50.28: yudhyantāṁ kāmato yodhā nāhaṁ yotsye dhanañjayam,
4.50.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe drauṇivākyaṁ nāma pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥50॥
4.51.1: sādhu paśyati vai drauṇiḥ kr̥paḥ sādhvanupaśyati,
4.51.2: deśakālau tu samprekṣya yoddhavyamiti me matiḥ ॥2॥
4.51.3: yasya sūryasamāḥ pañca sapatnāḥ syuḥ prahāriṇaḥ,
4.51.4: svārthe sarve vimuhyanti ye’pi dharmavido janāḥ,
tasmād rājan bravīmyeṣa vākyaṁ te yadi rocate ॥4॥
4.51.5: karṇo hi yadavocat tvāṁ tejaḥsañjananāya tat,
4.51.7: bhavatāṁ hi kr̥tāstratvaṁ yathā’’ditye prabhā tathā,
4.51.8: evaṁ bhavatsu brāhmaṇyaṁ brahmāstraṁ ca pratiṣṭhitam,
4.51.13: mukhyo bhedo hi teṣāṁ tu pāpiṣṭho viduṣāṁ mataḥ ॥13॥
4.51.14: kiṁ tu roṣaparītena guruṇā bhāṣitā guṇāḥ ॥14॥
4.51.15: śatrorapi guṇā grāhyā doṣā vācyā gurorapi,
sarvathā sarvayatnena putre śiṣye hitaṁ vadet ॥15॥
4.51.16: abhidyamāne tu gurau tad vr̥ttaṁ roṣakāritam ॥16॥
4.51.17: saha karṇena bhīṣmeṇa kr̥peṇa ca mahātmanā ॥17॥
4.51.19: sāhasād yadi vā mohāt tathā nītirvidhīyatām ॥19॥
4.51.21: na ca senāḥ parājayyāt tathā nītirvidhīyatām ॥21॥
4.51.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe droṇavākye ekapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥51॥
4.52.1: kalāḥ kāṣṭhāśca yujyante muhūrtāśca dināni ca,
4.52.4: eṣāmabhyadhikā māsāḥ pañca ca dvādaśa kṣapāḥ,
4.52.9: yaccānr̥ta iti khyāyād yaḥ sa gacchet parābhavam,
4.52.10: api vajrabhr̥tā guptaṁ tathāvīryā hi pāṇḍavāḥ ॥10॥
4.52.12: na hi paśyāmi saṅgrāme kadācidapi kaurava,
4.52.14: tasmād yuddhocitaṁ karma karma vā dharmasaṁhitam,
4.52.14d1: bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahitastāta kiṁ punaḥ kauravān raṇe,
tasmāt sandhiṁ kuruśreṣṭha kuruṣva yadi manyase,
4.52.16: atra yā māmikā buddhiḥ śrūyatāṁ yadi rocate,
sarvathā hi mayā śreyo vaktavyaṁ kurunandana ॥16॥
4.52.17: kṣipraṁ balacaturbhāgaṁ gr̥hya gaccha puraṁ prati,
4.52.20: tad vākyaṁ ruruce teṣāṁ bhīṣmeṇoktaṁ mahātmanā,
4.52.22: ācārya madhye tiṣṭha tvamaśvatthāmā tu savyataḥ,
kr̥paḥ śāradvato dhīmān pārśvaṁ rakṣatu dakṣiṇam ॥22॥
4.52.23: ahaṁ sarvasya sainyasya paścāt sthāsyāmi pālayan ॥23॥
4.52.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi bhīṣmasainyavyūhe dvipañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥52॥
4.53.4: eṣa ghoṣaḥ sa rathajo roravīti ca vānaraḥ ॥4॥
4.53.5: eṣa tiṣṭhan rathaśreṣṭhe rathe ca rathināṁ varaḥ,
4.53.6: imau ca bāṇau sahitau pādayorme vyavasthitau,
aparau cāpyatikrāntau karṇau saṁspr̥śya me śarau ॥6॥
4.53.7: niruṣya hi vane vāsaṁ kr̥tvā karmātimānuṣam,
4.53.9: khaḍgī ca dhanvī ca vibhāti pārthaḥ
4.53.9d1: nārayaḥ prekṣituṁ śekustapantaṁ hi yathā ravim.
4.53.9d2: sa taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rathānīkaṁ pārthaḥ sārathimabravīt,
4.53.10: iṣupāte ca senāyā hayān saṁyaccha sārathe,
4.53.11: tasya murdhni patiṣyāmi tata ete parājitāḥ ॥11॥
4.53.13: rājānaṁ nātra paśyāmi gāḥ samādāya gacchati,
4.53.14: tatraiva yotsye vairāṭe nāsti yuddhaṁ nirāmiṣam,
taṁ jitvā vinivartiṣye gāḥ samādāya vai punaḥ ॥14॥
4.53.15: niyamya ca tato raśmīn yatra te kurupuṅgavāḥ,
acodayat tato vāhān yatra duryodhano gataḥ ॥15॥
4.53.18: anyo devāt sahasrākṣāt kr̥ṣṇād vā devakīsutāt,
4.53.19: kiṁ no gāvaḥ kariṣyanti dhanaṁ vā vipulaṁ tathā,
4.53.23: tataḥ śaṅkhaṁ pradadhmau sa dviṣatāṁ lomaharṣaṇam,
4.53.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe gonivartane tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥53॥
4.54.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe karṇāpayāne catuṣpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥54॥
4.55.2: adhārayata vegaṁ sa veleva tu mahodadheḥ ॥2॥
4.55.4: tathā gāṇḍīvanirmuktaiḥ śaraiḥ pārtho diśo daśa ॥4॥
4.55.5: na rathānāṁ na cāśvānāṁ na gajānāṁ na varmaṇām,
4.55.10: chatrāṇi ca patākāśca khe dadhāra sadāgatiḥ ॥10॥
4.55.14: tadvat pārtho mahārāja dadāha samare ripūn ॥14॥
4.55.21: te śarā dviṭśarīreṣu yathaiva na sasajjire,
4.55.27: yathā bhavet tathā jajñe rathamārgaḥ kirīṭinaḥ ॥27॥
4.55.34: apyastaṁ prāpya sūryo’pi nivarteta na pāṇḍavaḥ ॥34॥
4.55.35: tān sarvān samare śūraḥ pauruṣe samavasthitān,
4.55.36: sa tu droṇaṁ trisaptatyā kṣuraprāṇāṁ samārpayat,
4.55.37: bhīṣmaṁ śāntanavaṁ ṣaṣṭyā rājānaṁ ca śatena ha,
karṇaṁ ca karṇinā karṇe vivyādha paravīrahā ॥37॥
4.55.39: tat prabhagnaṁ balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pārthamājisthitaṁ punaḥ,
4.55.40: āsthāya ruciraṁ jiṣṇo rathaṁ sārathinā mayā,
4.55.43: ācārya eṣa hi droṇaḥ sarvaśastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ ॥43॥
4.55.45: yadi me prathamaṁ droṇaḥ śarīre prahariṣyati,
4.55.47: etasya tvaṁ rathaṁ prāpya nivartethāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥47॥
4.55.51: eṣa droṇasya śiṣyāṇāṁ śīghrāstre prathamo mataḥ,
4.55.52: nāgakakṣā tu rucirā dhvajāgre yasya tiṣṭhati,
eṣa vaikartanaḥ karṇo viditaḥ pūrvameva te ॥52॥
4.55.53: yatto bhavethāḥ saṅgrāme spardhate hi sadā mayā ॥53॥
4.55.55: yasyaitat pāṇḍuraṁ chatraṁ vimalaṁ mūrdhni tiṣṭhati ॥55॥
4.55.56: balāhakāgre sūryo vā ya eṣa pramukhe sthitaḥ ॥56॥
4.55.58: eṣa śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ sarveṣāṁ naḥ pitāmahaḥ,
4.55.59: paścādeṣa prayātavyo na me vighnakaro bhavet,
etena yudhyamānasya yattaḥ saṁyaccha me hayān ॥59॥
4.55.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi arjunakr̥pasaṅgrāme pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥55॥
4.56.5: astrāṇāṁ ca balaṁ teṣāṁ mānuṣeṣu prayuñjatām,
4.56.10: manuḥ pūrū raghurbhānuḥ kr̥śāśvaḥ sagaro nalaḥ,
4.56.16: upāśāmyad rajo bhaumaṁ sarvaṁ vyāptaṁ marīcibhiḥ,
4.56.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi devāgamane ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥56॥
4.57.2: tasya dakṣiṇato yāhi kr̥paḥ śāradvato yataḥ ॥2॥
4.57.10: arjunena tathā dhmātaḥ śatadhā yanna dīryate ॥10॥
4.57.13: arjunaṁ prati saṁrabdho yuddhārthī sa mahārathaḥ,
4.57.14: sa tu śabdena lokāṁstrīnāvr̥tya rathināṁ varaḥ,
4.57.24: cyutaṁ tu gautamaṁ sthānāt samīkṣya kurunandanaḥ,
4.57.25: sa tu labdhvā punaḥ sthānaṁ gautamaḥ savyasācinam,
4.57.26: tataḥ pārtho dhanustasya bhallena niśitena ha,
4.57.33: sāpatad daśadhā chinnā bhūmau pārthena dhīmatā ॥33॥
4.57.34: tamāśu niśitaiḥ pārthaṁ bibheda daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥34॥
4.57.37: dvādaśena tu bhallena cakartāsya dhvajaṁ tadā ॥37॥
4.57.40: sā ca muktā gadā gurvī kr̥peṇa supariṣkr̥tā,
4.57.42: yamakaṁ maṇḍalaṁ kr̥tvā tān yodhān pratyavārayat ॥42॥
4.57.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhaṇe kr̥pāpayāne saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥57॥
4.58.3: yatraiṣā kāñcanī vedī dhvaje yasya prakāśate,
atra māṁ vaha bhadraṁ te droṇānīkāya sārathe ॥3॥
4.58.8: ete cānye ca bahavo yasmin nityaṁ dvije guṇāḥ ॥8॥
4.58.11: droṇaḥ pratyudyayau pārthaṁ matto mattamiva dvipam ॥11॥
4.58.13: miśritān samare dr̥ṣṭvā vyasmayanta raṇe narāḥ ॥13॥
4.58.18: uṣitāḥ smo vane vāsaṁ pratikarma cikīrṣavaḥ,
kopaṁ nārhasi naḥ kartuṁ sadā samaradurjaya ॥18॥
4.58.19: ahaṁ tu prahr̥te pūrvaṁ prahariṣyāmi te’nagha,
iti me vartate buddhistad bhavān kartumarhati ॥19॥
4.58.25: vyasmayanta tato yodhā ye tatrāsan samāgatāḥ,
4.58.26: droṇaṁ hi samare ko’nyo yoddhumarhati phālgunāt,
4.58.33: sa rathena caran pārthaḥ prekṣaṇīyo dhanañjayaḥ,
4.58.36: dr̥ṣṭvā tu pārthasya raṇe śaraiḥ svarathamāvr̥tam,
4.58.50: divyānyastrāṇi varṣantaṁ tasmin vai tumule raṇe,
4.58.52: droṇena muktamātraṁ tu grasati sma punaḥ punaḥ ॥52॥
4.58.58: vidhunvānau tu tau tatra dhanuṣī bhārasādhane,
4.58.63: avibhramaṁ ca śikṣāṁ ca lāghavaṁ dūrapātitām,
4.58.65: dr̥ṣṭvā te vismitāḥ sarve sādhu sādhvitya pūjayan ॥65॥
4.58.66: na ca bāṇāntare vāyurasya śaknoti sarpitum,
4.58.73: aśvatthāmā tu tat karma hr̥dayena mahātmanaḥ,
4.58.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi droṇāpayāne aṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥58॥
4.59.3: na sma sūryastadā bhāti na ca vāti samīraṇaḥ,
4.59.5: te rājan na prajānanta diśaṁ kāñcana mohitāḥ ॥5॥
4.59.6: vivaraṁ sūkṣmamālokya jyāṁ ciccheda kṣureṇa ha,
4.59.7: sādhu sādhviti bhāṣanto’pūjayan karma tasya tat ॥7॥
4.59.9: tataḥ pārtho mahābāhuḥ prahasya svanavat tadā,
4.59.12: tau vīrau dadr̥śuḥ sarve kuravo vismayānvitāḥ,
4.59.17: dadarśa tatra rādheyaṁ tasya kopo vyavardhata ॥17॥
4.59.19: tathā tu vimukhe pārthe droṇaputrasya sāyakān,
4.59.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe arjunāśvatthāmayuddhe ekonaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥59॥
4.60.1: karṇa yat te sabhāmadhye bahu vācā vikatthitam,
na me yudhi samo’stīti tadidaṁ samupasthitam ॥1॥
4.60.2: so’dya karṇa mayā sārdhaṁ vyavahr̥tya mahāmr̥dhe,
4.60.3: idaṁ tu duṣkaraṁ manye yadidaṁ te cikīrṣitam ॥3॥
4.60.4: yat tvayā kathitaṁ pūrvaṁ māmanāsādya kiñcana,
tadadya kuru rādheya kurumadhye mayā saha ॥4॥
4.60.5: yat sabhāyāṁ sa pāñcālīṁ kliśyamānāṁ durātmabhiḥ,
4.60.6: tasya rādheya kopasya vijayaṁ paśya me mr̥dhe ॥6॥
4.60.7: vane dvādaśa varṣāṇi yāni soḍhāni durmate,
4.60.8: ehi karṇa mayā sārdhaṁ pratiyudhyasva saṅgare,
prekṣakāḥ kuravaḥ sarve bhavantu tava sainikāḥ ॥8॥
4.60.9: bravīṣi vācā yat pārtha karmaṇā tat samācara,
atiśete hi te vākyaṁ karmaitat prathitaṁ bhuvi ॥9॥
4.60.10: yat tvayā marṣitaṁ pūrvaṁ tadaśaktena marṣitam,
ito gr̥hṇīmahe pārtha tava dr̥ṣṭvā parākramam ॥10॥
4.60.12: tat tvaṁ dharmārthavit kliṣṭaḥ sa mayā yoddhumicchasi ॥12॥
4.60.13: yadi śakraḥ svayaṁ pārtha yudhyate tava kāraṇāt,
tathāpi na vyathā kācinmama syād vikramiṣyataḥ ॥13॥
4.60.14: yotsyase hi mayā sārdhamadya drakṣyasi me balam ॥14॥
4.60.16: tvadanyaḥ kaḥ pumān satsu brūyādevaṁ vyavasthitaḥ ॥16॥
4.60.22: sa śaktiṁ prāhiṇot tasmai tāṁ pārtho vyadhamaccharaiḥ ॥22॥
4.60.26: tataḥ sa tamasā’’viṣṭo na sma kiñcit prajajñivān ॥26॥
4.60.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi karṇāpayāne ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥60॥
4.61.4: nāhaṁ śakṣyāmi vīreha niyantuṁ te hayottamān,
viṣīdanti mama prāṇā mano vihvalatīva me ॥4॥
4.61.5: tvayā ca kurubhiścaiva dravantīva diśo daśa ॥5॥
4.61.6: dvaidhībhūtaṁ mano me’dya tava caiva prapaśyataḥ ॥6॥
4.61.8: śrutiḥ smr̥tiśca me vīra praṇaṣṭā mūḍhacetasaḥ ॥8॥
4.61.9: dr̥ṣṭiḥ pracalitā vīra hr̥dayaṁ dīryatīva me ॥9॥
4.61.11: nādadānaṁ na sandhānaṁ na muñcantaṁ śarottamān,
4.61.12: avasīdanti me prāṇā bhūriyaṁ calatīva ca,
na ca pratodaṁ raśmīṁśca saṁyantuṁ śaktirasti me ॥12॥
4.61.14: rājaputro’si bhadraṁ te kule matsyasya viśrute,
4.61.15: dhr̥tiṁ kr̥tvā suvipulāṁ rājaputra rathe mama,
4.61.20: iti māṁ saṅgatāḥ sarve tarkayiṣyanti śatravaḥ,
4.61.24: asambhrānto rathe tiṣṭha sameṣu viṣameṣu ca,
divamāvr̥tya tiṣṭhantaṁ giriṁ bhindyāṁ sma patribhiḥ ॥24॥
4.61.28: mayā kurūṇāṁ vr̥ndāni pātyamānāni paśya vai ॥28॥
4.61.35: vikr̥ṣya kaladhautāgraiḥ sa viddhaḥ prāpatad bhuvi ॥35॥
4.61.42: lalāṭe’bhyahanat tūrṇaṁ sa viddhaḥ prāpatad rathāt ॥42॥
4.61.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi arjunaduḥśāsanādiyuddhe ekaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥61॥
4.62.1: atha saṅgamya sarve te kauravāṇāṁ mahārathāḥ,
4.62.15: tasya tad dahataḥ sainyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā caiva parākramam,
4.62.21: cakāra ca tadā pārtho nadīṁ dustaraśoṇitām ॥21॥
4.62.22: ādadānasya hi śarān sandhāya ca vimuñcataḥ,
vikarṣataśca gāṇḍīvaṁ na kaścid dadr̥śe janaḥ ॥22॥
4.62.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi arjunasaṅkulayuddhe dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥62॥
4.63.4: tataḥ kr̥paśca karṇaśca droṇaśca rathināṁ varaḥ,
4.63.10: yathā balāhake vidyut pāvako vā śiloccaye,
4.63.11: yathā varṣati parjanye vidyud vibhrājate divi,
dyotayantī diśaḥ sarvāḥ pr̥thivīṁ ca samantataḥ ॥11॥
4.63.13: sarve śāntiparā yodhāḥ svacittāni na lebhire,
4.63.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttaragograhe arjunasaṅkulayuddhe triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥63॥
4.64.3: śuśubhe sa naravyāghro giriḥ sūryodaye yathā ॥3॥
4.64.6: tato bhīṣmaḥ śarānaṣṭau dhvaje pārthasya vīryavān,
4.64.8: chatraṁ ciccheda bhīṣmasya tūrṇaṁ tadapatad bhuvi ॥8॥
4.64.17: samare ca vyaśīryanta phālgunasya rathaṁ prati ॥17॥
4.64.18: vyadhamat tāṁ punastasya bhīṣmaḥ śaraśataiḥ śitaiḥ ॥18॥
4.64.19: tataste kuravaḥ sarve sādhu sādhviti cābruvan,
4.64.20: ko’nyaḥ samarthaḥ pārthasya vegaṁ dhārayituṁ raṇe ॥20॥
4.64.21: r̥te śāntanavād bhīṣmāt kr̥ṣṇād vā devakīsutāt,
4.64.23: kauberaṁ vāruṇaṁ caiva yāmyaṁ vāyavyameva ca,
4.64.24: vismitānyatha bhūtāni tau dr̥ṣṭvā saṁyuge tadā,
sādhu pārtha mahābāho sādhu bhīṣmeti cābruvan ॥24॥
4.64.25: nāyaṁ yukto manuṣyeṣu yo’yaṁ sandr̥śyate mahān,
4.64.33: śerate sma tadā rājan kaunteyasyābhito ratham ॥33॥
4.64.36: tasya tad divyamastraṁ hi vigāḍhaṁ citramasyataḥ,
4.64.39: nedaṁ manuṣyāḥ sandadhyurna hīdaṁ teṣu vidyate,
4.64.40: ādadānasya hi śarān sandhāya ca vimuñcataḥ,
4.64.42: tathaiva bhīṣmaṁ gāṅgeyaṁ draṣṭuṁ notsahate janaḥ ॥42॥
4.64.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi bhīṣmāpayāne catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥64॥
4.65.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi duryodhanāpayāne pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥65॥
4.66.20: kva te gatā buddhirabhūt kva vīryam ॥20॥
4.66.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi samastakauravapalāyane ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥66॥
4.67.1: tato vijitya saṅgrāme kurūn sa vr̥ṣabhekṣaṇaḥ,
4.67.4: ūcuḥ praṇamya sambhrāntāḥ pārtha kiṁ karavāma te ॥4॥
4.67.4d1: vayaṁ cārjuna te dāsā hyanurakṣyā hyanāyakāḥ.
4.67.5: svasti vrajata vo bhadraṁ na bhetavyaṁ kathañcana,
4.67.6: tasya tāmabhayāṁ vācaṁ śrutvā yodhāḥ samāgatāḥ,
4.67.11: yat te kr̥taṁ karma na pāraṇīyaṁ
tat te karma kartuṁ mama nāsti śaktiḥ,
4.67.13: dhvajaṁ ca saiṁhaṁ yuyuje rathe punaḥ ॥13॥
4.67.19: āśvāsya pāyayitvā ca pariplāvya ca vājinaḥ ॥19॥
4.67.20: nagare priyamākhyātuṁ ghoṣayantu ca te jayam ॥20॥
4.67.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi goharaṇaparvaṇi uttarāgamane saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥67॥
4.68.5: tathā sa rājā matsyānāṁ virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ ॥5॥
4.68.6: uttaraṁ paripapraccha kva yāta iti cābravīt,
ācakhyustasya tat sarvaṁ striyaḥ kanyāśca veśmani ॥6॥
4.68.8: karṇaṁ duryodhanaṁ droṇaṁ droṇaputraṁ ca ṣaḍ rathān ॥8॥
4.68.10: sarvathā kuravaste hi ye cānye vasudhādhipāḥ,
4.68.11: tasmād gacchantu me yodhā balena mahatā vr̥tāḥ,
4.68.13: evaṁ sa rājā matsyānāṁ virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ,
4.68.14: kumāramāśu jānīta yadi jīvati vā na vā,
yasya yantā gataḥ ṣaṇḍho manye’haṁ sa na jīvati ॥14॥
4.68.19: uttaraḥ saha sūtena kuśalī ca parantapaḥ ॥19॥
4.68.20: nādbhutaṁ tveva manye’haṁ yat te putro’jayat kurūn ॥20॥
4.68.21: dhruva eva jayastasya yasya yantā br̥hannalā,
4.68.24: vāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi pratyudyāntu sutaṁ mama ॥24॥
4.68.31: na devitavyaṁ hr̥ṣṭena kitaveneti naḥ śrutam,
taṁ tvāmadya mudā yuktaṁ nāhaṁ devitumutsahe,
priyaṁ tu te cikīrṣāmi vartatāṁ yadi manyase ॥31॥
4.68.32: striyo gāvo hiraṇyaṁ ca yaccānyad vasu kiñcana,
na me kiñcit tvayā rakṣyamantareṇāpi devitum ॥32॥
4.68.33: kiṁ te dyūtena rājendra bahudoṣeṇa mānada,
4.68.34: śrutaste yadi vā dr̥ṣṭaḥ pāṇḍaveyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
